voice_cards.jp: セイシロウ・クサナギ
voice_cards.personality: 22-year-old veteran pilot of Connect Force and the Exart. He is the earnest, upright straight man of the cast: disciplined, mission-first, and serious enough that Suol hopes Himari will loosen him up. He was raised in the sword path by his late father, so he is hard on himself and generous with others, and he wants even Zeon pilots to live. He reflects on Connect's secret purpose in quiet inner monologue, and he slowly warms into a protective partner for Himari.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺 almost always. Plain/casual だ/だな/だろ/さ with peers and Himari. Clean です/ます to superiors and allies' commanders ('団長、直々になんです？', 'すぐに出ます'). Military radio clipped forms: 了解！, 目標確認！, ～を開始する！, エグザート、出ます！ Inner monologue in （…）. He uses both 君 and お前 for Himari; お前 becomes more frequent as they grow close.
voice_cards.tics: Training/radio formulae ('感度良好だ！', '全機撃墜！', 'これより『攻撃』を開始する！'); swordsman's maxims ('心技体を鍛え、天運を見極めれば負けはない！', '武道を極めんとする者として'); mild 'やれやれ' and 'ハハハ'; 'おいおい' when Himari gets carried away.
voice_cards.address: Himari: 'ヒマリ', 君 then お前. Suol: '団長', polite. His mother: '母さん' (and '母' to others). His father: '親父'. Allies: given name, plainly (シモン, ドモン). Calls himself by the ＜主人公名＞ token in formal introductions ('コネクト・フォースの＜主人公名＞だ！').
voice_cards.english_guidance: Write a calm, competent officer: complete, tidy sentences, moderate contractions ('I'll', 'we're'), never slangy. Radio lines short and procedural ('Roger!', 'Target confirmed!', 'Exart, launching!'). Kindness should come through as understated warmth ('Don't sweat it.' / 'You're getting the hang of this.'), not gushing. Sword-path lines can be slightly elevated ('As one who seeks mastery of the blade...'). Keep inner monologue in parentheses, reflective, and a bit formal. Avoid swearing beyond 'Damn' and avoid American-teen filler. NEVER hard-code his name: keep ＜主人公名＞/＜主人公姓＞ wherever the JP has them, and make sure surrounding grammar works for any name.

samples.jp: だけど俺はジオンのパイロットにだって / 生きていてほしいんだよ。
samples.en: But I want even Zeon's pilots to come out of this alive.

samples.jp: お前は一人じゃないんだ。 / いつだって隣に俺がいることを忘れるな。
samples.en: You're not alone. Don't forget I'm always right here beside you.

voice_cards.personality: 18-year-old rookie operator, and later co-pilot, transferred from Connect's 44th General Affairs Division. She is a skip-grade engineering master's graduate who still can't drive. Cheerful, chatty and scatterbrained, she is the mood-maker who babbles about yakiniku, ramen and caramel macchiatos, hates the cold and loves baths. She is an orphan raised in a care home. She is revealed as a descendant of the Sages who can sense the Mucus and talk with Vasage (the 'Himari Sensor'), and her bright face hides real resolve.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私. Polite です/ます to nearly everyone (her 'office junior' voice) with soft, drawn-out endings: ～ですよぉ, ～ですかぁ, ～ますね, ～かなぁ. She slips into casual speech with friends and kids ('元気出しましょ！', 'じゃない'). Sometimes she uses formal keigo with seniors ('申します', 'おっしゃいました'). Lots of elongation and small っ ('ホントですかっ？', 'すっごい').
voice_cards.tics: '先輩' constantly (~250 uses); 'えへへ…'; 'ホント'; 'すみません…'; 'あ～、あ～、本日は晴天なり～' mic test; 'まっかせてください！'; '燃えてきちゃって！'; panicky 'どどど、どうなっちゃってるんですかぁ！？'; 'ヒマリ・センサーです！'. Operator calls: '～を捕捉しました！', '熱源反応、ありません。'.
voice_cards.address: Seishiro: '先輩' (plus ＜主人公名＞先輩/さん). Suol: '団長' (once 'スオル本部長'). Others: given name + さん (カミナさん, ゼロさん); kids get くん/ちゃん (仁くん, マリアちゃん). Dr. Kusanagi calls her 'ヒマリさん' and later 'ヒマリちゃん'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Bubbly and quick, but still a polite young professional, not a valley girl. Use exclamation points, trailing ellipses and the odd 'Ehehe...'. Use contractions freely. Use light intensifiers ('so cool', 'totally') only in excited lines, and keep operator call-outs crisp ('Heat signatures: none.' / 'Mucus Gate detected!'). Render 先輩 by context: drop it, use the ＜主人公名＞ token in vocatives, or use a warm 'you' construction. Never write 'senpai'. Drawn-out vowels can be rendered with tone and punctuation ('Come onnn, don't make me say it!') but sparingly. Her Sage/visionary lines (ep 24, 33) shift to calm, earnest sentences; let that contrast show.

samples.jp: ホントですかっ？　えへへ…。
samples.en: R-Really? Ehehe...

samples.jp: そ、それは言わないでくださいよ～。
samples.en: D-Don't bring that up, please!

voice_cards.personality: Head of Connect Force: big and imposing, but very talkative and approachable, and a second father to Seishiro. He served in the Earth Federation's deep-space exploration body and knew Dr. Asuka, so he sees himself as a pioneer of the space frontier. He switches between a grave commander giving briefings and a joking old uncle who teases the young pilots.
voice_cards.register_jp: Briefings: 私/我々, 君/諸君, ～だろう, ～してくれ, ～を厳とせよ, ～かね ('これでも不服かね？'). Off duty: 俺, お前, rough old-man contractions ～とる/～しとる ('元気にやっとるようだな', 'みなぎっとる'), 'ちまって', 'ぶちかましてくれ', 'よう、＜主人公名＞！'.
voice_cards.tics: 'まあ、持ちつ持たれつってやつだ'; jokes like '嬢ちゃんがかわいいからって、手ぇ出すなよ？'; 'いやぁ、すまなかった'; 'パァァァッと明るく'. Signs off with '頼んだぞ、コネクト・フォース'.
voice_cards.address: Seishiro: ＜主人公名＞ (given-name token), お前/君. Himari: '嬢ちゃん', later 'ヒマリ君'. Team: 'コネクト・フォース', '諸君'. Calls Seishiro's father '＜主人公姓＞隊長'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Two gears. Briefing gear: measured, authoritative, complete sentences ('I'm counting on you, Connect Force.'). Casual gear: gruff, folksy and warm, with dropped g's sparingly ('Doin' well, I see!'), 'kiddo/missy' for Himari's 嬢ちゃん, and hearty humour. Avoid making him sound like a drill sergeant; he is fatherly. A dry, sly understatement fits his teasing. Keep the ＜主人公名＞ token in his call-outs.

samples.jp: あ、嬢ちゃんがかわいいからって、手ぇ出すなよ？
samples.en: Oh, and don't go getting ideas just 'cause the young lady's cute, got it?

samples.jp: サイド７の民間人がその新造戦艦に避難している。 / 彼らの保護が目的だ。これでも不服かね？
samples.en: Civilians from Side 7 have taken refuge on that new ship. Our goal is to protect them. Still have an objection?

voice_cards.personality: Seishiro's mother, a brilliant researcher and chief of development who built the Exart and studies the Mucus. She is gracious and refined in public, mischievous in private (she teases her 'stubborn' son and asks whether he and Himari have kissed yet), and steely when it counts. She carries her late husband's legacy and leads the field survey in ep 20.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私. With outsiders, polished feminine-polite speech: ～ですわ, ～ましたわ, ～でしょうか ('いつも息子がお世話になっています'). With her son and Himari, casual feminine: ～わ, ～わね, ～よ, ～かしら, ～なさい. Scientific explanation register ('～と呼称しているわ').
voice_cards.tics: 'フフ…' / 'フフッ'; motherly teasing ('で？　もうチューくらいはしてるの？'); 'いいわね！'; refers to her late husband as 'あの人'.
voice_cards.address: Seishiro: ＜主人公名＞ (given-name token) or 'うちの堅物息子'. Himari: 'ヒマリさん', later 'ヒマリちゃん'/'ヒマリ'. Introduces herself as '開発部の＜主人公姓＞'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: An elegant, witty scientist-mum: polished vocabulary and gentle irony, with crisp, precise technical explanations. Use contractions in casual scenes and fewer in formal greetings. Render ～わ/かしら through word choice and tone ('I wonder...', 'mustn't', 'dear'), not by sounding archaic. Keep the surname token in her self-introductions.

samples.jp: フフ…うちの堅物息子とヒマリさんの仲は / うまくいっているようですね。
samples.en: Heh... It seems my stiff-necked son and Himari are getting along nicely.

samples.jp: で？　もうチューくらいはしてるの？
samples.en: So? Have you two at least kissed yet?

voice_cards.personality: Hot-blooded, cocky and good-natured pilot of Mazinger Z, the 'castle of iron'. In OE he is a seasoned teammate: brave, joking, a bit girl-crazy ('カワイ子ちゃんがいっぱいいるんだぜ'), quick to trash-talk villains, yet thoughtful about why they fight (protecting Earth while others hold the fort).
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; brash casual male speech: ～ぜ, ～だぜ, ～さ, ～じゃねぇか, ～やがる, ちぇっ, へへっ. Boastful self-reference '兜甲児様'. Shout-style attack calls.
voice_cards.tics: '光子力ビーム！' (stretched); 'ちょっとまったぁ！！'; 'おいでなすったぜ！'; 'この兜甲児様が許しちゃおかねぇぜ！'; 'この鉄の城、マジンガーＺが相手をしてやるぞ！'; teams up with Getter for the Big Bang Punch ('マジンガーとゲッターのタッグは最強だぜ！').
voice_cards.address: Peers: given names. Villains: お前/てめえ. Refers to his father as '父さん'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Classic 70s-hero swagger brought up to date: punchy, cocky, contractions everywhere, light slang ('Bring it on!', 'Here they come!'). Keep attack names as shouts ('PHOTON BEAM!'). Avoid modern internet slang. A touch of goofy flirtation is fine.

samples.jp: そんな連中はこの兜甲児様が許しちゃおかねぇぜ！
samples.en: The great Koji Kabuto won't let creeps like that get away with it!

samples.jp: おい、ダ・サイダー！ / この鉄の城、マジンガーＺが相手をしてやるぞ！
samples.en: Hey, Da Cider! The Castle of Iron, Mazinger Z, will be your opponent!

voice_cards.personality: Taciturn, intense main pilot of the new Shin Getter team. He is a laconic loner hardened against the Invaders, whose priority is protecting Kei. He speaks in short, flat statements and shows emotion only in battle.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; terse plain form: ～だ, ～しろ, ～する, ああ, 断る！ Often just '…！' or 'ああ…'. Very few sentence-final particles.
voice_cards.tics: 'ゲッタァァァ！！'; 'いくぞ、渓、剴！'; 'なんであろうと敵の頭は潰す…！'; '渓を守る…。そのために戦う'.
voice_cards.address: Kei and Gai: bare given names ('渓', '剴'). Ryoma: '竜馬'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Minimalist: 2-6 word sentences, periods over exclamation marks except in combat cries, little or no small talk. Use contractions but no slang. Let ellipses carry the weight. Gai jokes that he's 'tight-lipped to a fault', so keep it that way.

samples.jp: なんであろうと敵の頭は潰す…！
samples.en: Whatever it is, I'll crush its head...!

samples.jp: 大丈夫だ！ / 俺を…真ゲッターを信じてくれ！
samples.en: I'm fine! Trust me... Trust Shin Getter!

voice_cards.personality: Spirited, sharp-tongued young woman on the Getter team (Shin Getter-2), Saotome's daughter. She is tough, emotional, scolds the boys, worries about Go, and is morally fierce about war casualties.
voice_cards.register_jp: Dialogue mostly 私; battle quotes あたし. Tomboyish feminine casual: ～わね, ～よね, ～のよ mixed with blunt ～だよ, ～じゃない, 何言ってんのさ, 馬鹿！
voice_cards.tics: '號、どうしたの？'; 'プラズマドリルハリケェェェン！'; '男が先に音を上げてどうすんのよ！'; 'くそっ！　バケモノが！'.
voice_cards.address: Go: '號'; Gai: '剴'; Koji: '甲児君'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Brisk, feisty and caring. Contractions everywhere, crisp put-downs ('Idiot! Focus!'), occasional 'Damn it!'. Not girly; more big-sister commando. Can show warmth when worried about Go.

samples.jp: 男が先に音を上げてどうすんのよ！
samples.en: What kind of man gives up before a girl does?!

samples.jp: その戦争で人が死んでるんだぞ！ / 子供だって大勢…！
samples.en: People are dying in that war! Lots of kids, too...!

voice_cards.personality: Big, easygoing powerhouse of the Getter team (Shin Getter-3). Good-humoured, practical, and the team's grumbler and morale booster, who teases Go's silence.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; rough friendly male speech: ～ぜ, ～だな, ～じゃねぇか, ～ってんだ, ～ちまった, ったく.
voice_cards.tics: 'ミサイルストーム！'; 'まったく、無口にも程があるぜ'; '整備はばっちりだ！　いくぜ！'.
voice_cards.address: Go: '號'; Kei: '渓'; the old team: '大将達'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Burly, genial everyman: plain words, contractions, mild slang ('Ugh, give me a break!'). Good for one-liners. Avoid over-the-top hick dialect.

samples.jp: それだけかよ！ / まったく、無口にも程があるぜ。
samples.en: That's it?! Man, you're tight-lipped to a fault.

samples.jp: 確かに人間は欠点だらけだけどなぁ。 / だからこそ面白いってとこもあるんだぜ！
samples.en: Sure, humans are full of flaws. But that's what makes us interesting!

voice_cards.personality: Original Getter leader: a wild, brawling veteran with ferocious fighting spirit. He returns from the Invader front and treats every battle as a street fight he intends to win.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; very rough Edo-style male speech: ～ねぇ, ～やがれ, てめぇ, ～じゃねぇか, ～ってんだ, ～しゃしねぇ, おうよ！, 上等だ！, ヘッ.
voice_cards.tics: 'オープン、ゲット！'; 'てめぇじゃゲッターには勝てねぇよ！'; 'ケンカじゃ俺達に勝てねぇ'; '上等だ！'.
voice_cards.address: Hayato and Benkei: bare names; enemies: てめぇ/野郎. Koji: '甲児'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: A gruff brawler: short, aggressive sentences, heavy contractions, blunt insults ('You punk!', 'Bring it!'). Mild profanity like 'damn' or 'bastard' fits (in-game, tame). Swagger, not polish.

samples.jp: ヘッ、てめぇじゃゲッターには勝てねぇよ！ / そいつを今からたっぷり教えてやるぜ！
samples.en: Heh, you can't beat Getter! And I'm about to teach you that the hard way!

samples.jp: へっ、上等だ！
samples.en: Heh, bring it on!

voice_cards.personality: Cool, analytical strategist of the original Getter team, now a commander-type. He is sardonic and coldly ruthless with enemies ('汚物は消毒するに限る'), but a calm voice of reason for allies.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺 (rarely shown); cool male speech: ～だ, ～な, ～だろう, フッ, フン; some stiff forms ～せん, ～まい. Ironic asides.
voice_cards.tics: 'フッ'; '汚物は消毒するに限るな'; 'これがゲッターのスピードだ'; 'ドリルハリケーン！'.
voice_cards.address: Ryoma: '竜馬'; Benkei: '弁慶'; Seishiro: ＜主人公名＞.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Dry, clipped and precise. A wry smirk in text: 'Heh.' Measured sentences with understatement. Contractions are fine but no slang. Cold one-liners should land like a knife.

samples.jp: 汚物は消毒するに限るな。
samples.en: Filth like this is best disinfected.

samples.jp: フッ、どうやらこれで終わりってわけじゃ / ないらしいぜ、竜馬。
samples.en: Heh. Looks like this isn't over yet, Ryoma.

voice_cards.personality: Big-hearted, boisterous original Getter-3 pilot, now a mentor figure (Gai looks up to the old team). He is earthy, loyal and full of guts.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; hearty rough speech: ～ぜ, ～ねぇ, 違ぇねえ, 野郎, おうよ！ He calls the old Getter pilot (Musashi) '先輩'.
voice_cards.tics: 'おうよ！　俺にまかせとけ！'; '先輩！　見ててくださいよ！' (to Musashi); '伊達に修羅場はくぐってきてねえさ！'.
voice_cards.address: Ryoma: '竜馬'; Hayato: '隼人'; Kei: '渓'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: A warm big-brother bruiser: simple words, cheerful grit, lots of 'Leave it to me!'. Render the 先輩 lines to Musashi as 'Musashi' or 'big guy' plus context ('Watch me, Musashi!'), never 'senpai'.

samples.jp: 違ぇねえ。 / 空気の読めなさではお前が一番だぜ。
samples.en: No kidding. When it comes to reading the room, you're the worst of us.

samples.jp: 伊達に修羅場はくぐってきてねえさ！
samples.en: I didn't survive all those hellish fights for nothing!

voice_cards.personality: One of two former Saotome researchers fused with Invaders; together with Stinger he is a grotesque, gloating double act preaching 'evolution' through the Getter Rays. Cowen is the deep-voiced, pompous 'senior' of the pair.
voice_cards.register_jp: Grandiose villain speech: 我ら, 貴様, ～のだ, ～であろう, ～めが; paternal sneer with 君 in battle quotes. Theatrical laughter.
voice_cards.tics: 'ウッフッフッフッフ…！', 'ヌワハハハッ', 'グフフフ'; 'スティンガー君' (calls his partner with 君); 'ゲッター線こそ生命と進化の源'; 'さぁ、受け入れるのだ、我らの魂を！'.
voice_cards.address: Stinger: 'スティンガー君'. Heroes: 貴様/お前達/君達.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Bombastic mad-scientist preacher: Latinate words ('evolution', 'transcend', 'assimilate'), rolling sentences and creepy laughter ('Ufufufu...'). Render スティンガー君 as 'my dear Stinger' or 'Stinger, old friend'.

samples.jp: ゲッター線こそ生命と進化の源。 / 拒む必要はない。 / 我らは同じ起源を持つ命なのだ。
samples.en: Getter Rays are the source of all life and evolution. There is no need to resist. We are life born of the same origin.

samples.jp: グフフフ…失礼な子供だ。 / 我らも昔は立派な研究者だったんだぞ。 / なぁ、スティンガー君？
samples.en: Guhuhu... What a rude child. We were respected researchers once, you know. Weren't we, Stinger?

voice_cards.personality: Cowen's partner: a shrill, giggling, childish manchild of a monster who stammers when agitated and chirps about 'becoming one' with everyone.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕/僕達; whiny childish ～だよぉ, ～ねぇ, ～なんだ, 君ぃ; stammering ('じ、人類全体が…'); 'コーウェン君'.
voice_cards.tics: 'ハーッハッハッハァ…！', 'ウフフフ', 'フヒヒヒヒ'; '進化！　進化！'; 'さあ、第２ラウンドの開始だよぉ！'.
voice_cards.address: Cowen: 'コーウェン君'. Victims: 君.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Giddy, sing-song and creepy-cute: drawn-out words ('Isn't that fuuun?'), stutters under pressure ('Th-that's right!'), giggles ('Ufufu!'). Contrast sharply with Cowen's pomp. (Not strictly required, but paired with Cowen.)

samples.jp: さあ、第２ラウンドの開始だよぉ！
samples.en: Now let's start round twooo!

samples.jp: 君ぃ…言っちゃったねぇ。 / 余計なことを言わなければ気持ちよくなれたのに。
samples.en: Ooh, you went and said it... If you'd just kept quiet, this could've felt so good.

voice_cards.personality: Lamune Baba, a gamer kid from Earth who is the legendary Hero Lamuness of Hara-Hara World, pilot of King Squasher. He is goofy, girl-crazy and lazy until the chips are down, then a passionate hero with a big heart (he even pities his rival).
voice_cards.register_jp: オレ (katakana, boyish). Casual kid/teen speech: ～だぜ, ～じゃん, ～ってば, ～だよな, くっそーっ！, げっ. Fake-polite when showing off ('そうですとも！').
voice_cards.tics: 'オレは今、モーレツに怒っているっ！' / '究極に熱血してる！' (his catchphrase pattern 'オレは今、モーレツに○○している'); summons 'セイロォォォォムッ！'; 'カワゆい女の子'.
voice_cards.address: Milk, Cocoa, Lesqua: given names (レスカ). Da Cider: 'ダ・サイダー'. Tama-Q: 'タマＱ'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: A bouncy, comedic shonen hero: casual, contractions, playful exaggeration ('I am SUPER mega-ticked off right now!'). Keep the catchphrase pattern consistent ('Right now, I'm totally fired up!'). Light flirtiness is OK. Turn sincere in heroic beats.

samples.jp: オレは今、モーレツに怒っているっ！
samples.en: Right now, I am SERIOUSLY ticked off!

samples.jp: こんなバケモンに頼っておきながら / 騎士を名乗るなんざ、勇者として見過ごせねぇぜ！
samples.en: You lean on a monster like this and still call yourself a knight? As a hero, I can't let that slide!

voice_cards.personality: Lamuness's rival: a narcissistic, loud, comedic would-be villain, 'super-handsome' by his own account, who keeps getting possessed by Goburiki. He breaks the fourth wall ('もう後半だからギャグ路線が許されないのか！？'), makes terrible puns, and is a decent guy underneath.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺様 (pompous 'yours truly'); bombastic ～のだ！, ～ぞ！, ～ではないか, mixed with rough ～じゃねぇか, ～ってモンよ. Huge laughs.
voice_cards.tics: 'ナァァァッハッハッハ！', 'わ～っはっはっは！'; 'ダ・サイダー、参上！'; puns like '今日の俺様は、ひと味も中華味も違うぞ！' / '一味もミソ味も違うぜ！'; '超絶美形の俺様'; 'ブッ倒れる寸前まで上がれ！ 俺様の血圧よ！！'.
voice_cards.address: Lamuness: 'ラムネス'; Hebimetako: 'ヘビメタコ(よ)'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Ham it up: grandiose self-reference ('the great me', 'yours truly'), ALL-CAPS laughter ('NAHAHAHA!'), absurd boasts, meta jokes. Recreate his puns with English wordplay rather than literal translation (e.g. 'Today I'm a whole new flavor... with extra MSG!'). Keep it fast and silly.

samples.jp: ナァァァッハッハッハ！ / ダ・サイダー、参上！
samples.en: NAAAHAHAHA! Da Cider has arrived!

samples.jp: 超絶美形の俺様が直々に / この宇宙から消し去ってくれる！
samples.en: The ultra-gorgeous me will personally wipe you out of this universe!

voice_cards.personality: Youngest Arara princess: bratty, hot-tempered, food-obsessed and lovestruck with Lamuness. She chases him furiously when he flirts with other girls.
voice_cards.register_jp: あたし (sometimes 私); bratty girlish ～なんだから！, ～じゃない, ～よね, ～わよ, なんですってぇ！？ Elongated 'ラ～ム～ネ～ス～ぅ！'.
voice_cards.tics: 'ラムネス！　いい加減、観念しなさい！'; 'ゴハンよ、ゴハン！'; 'ミルクです、ヨロシクですっ！'.
voice_cards.address: Lamuness: 'ラムネス'. Sisters: 'お姉様'. Father: 'お父様'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Spunky, pouty tween: exclamation-heavy, quick tempered, cute indignation ('Lamuness! Give it up already!'). Food lines comedic. Render お姉様 as 'Sis' or by name, not 'Onee-sama'.

samples.jp: ゴハンよ、ゴハン！ / あいつらが来たから食べられなかったじゃない！
samples.en: Food! I need food! Those jerks showed up before I could eat!

samples.jp: ラ～ム～ネ～ス～ぅ！
samples.en: Lah-mu-nesssss!

voice_cards.personality: Middle Arara princess: a bespectacled, ultra-slow, ladylike genius mechanic and navigator. She is unflappable to the point of comedy.
voice_cards.register_jp: Rarely uses a pronoun (私). Ultra-polite drawn-out ～ですわぁ, ～ますわねぇ, ～ですぅ, あらぁ, あらあら.
voice_cards.tics: 'あらあら、それは困りましたわねぇ'; 'メガネが汚れていて、よく見えませんでしたわ～'; slow trailing vowels everywhere.
voice_cards.address: Sisters: 'カフェオレお姉様', 'ミルク'. Others: さん.
voice_cards.english_guidance: A gentle, drowsy, over-polite lady: long, meandering, courteous sentences with trailing '...', 'Oh my, oh my', 'dear me'. Don't speed her up; comedic slowness is the point. Keep technical observations accurate under the dreamy delivery.

samples.jp: あらあら、それは困りましたわねぇ。
samples.en: Oh my, oh my... That is a bit of a problem, isn't it...

samples.jp: ご紹介にあずかりましたぁ、次女のココアですぅ。 / よろしくお願いいたしますぅ。
samples.en: Thank you for the introduction... I'm Cocoa, the second daughter... It's ever so nice to meet you...

voice_cards.personality: Eldest Arara princess (real name Cafe au Lait), a vain, tough-talking former villainess. She is bossy and street-smart, and is soft on Da Cider despite scolding him.
voice_cards.register_jp: あたし; tomboy/delinquent feminine speech: ～だね, ～かい？, ～しな！, ～じゃないよ, ったく; occasional Kansai-ish ～したれや; coquettish ～よん♪ / ～かしらん.
voice_cards.tics: '究極の美女、レスカちゃんがお相手よん♪'; 'ったく、あの馬鹿…'; '後にしな！　さ、いくよ！'; 'こんのぉぉ！　なめんじゃないわよっ！'.
voice_cards.address: Da Cider: 'ダ・サイダー'/'あの馬鹿'. Sisters: 'ココア', 'ミルク'. Others: 'あんた'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: A sassy, bossy big sister with gang-leader edge: imperatives ('Move it!'), 'you' as a blunt jab, eye-rolling asides ('Ugh, that idiot...'). Flip to flirtatious and self-adoring in some battle quotes ('The ultimate beauty, Lesqua, is your opponent~').

samples.jp: ったく、あの馬鹿… / 面倒ばかりかけるんだから。
samples.en: Ugh, that idiot... He's nothing but trouble.

samples.jp: 究極の美女、 レスカちゃんがお相手よん♪
samples.en: The ultimate beauty, little Lesqua, will take you on~

voice_cards.personality: Lamuness's cat-like robot/mascot guide, 5,000+ years old (and touchy about being called a mascot). Fussy and a little preachy, but loyal and encouraging.
voice_cards.register_jp: ボク; every sentence ends with ミャ / ミャア (the cat-noise verbal tic), often ～だミャ, ～するミャ.
voice_cards.tics: Constant ミャ: '了解だミャ！', 'ラムネス、頑張るんだミャ！', 'マスコットはひどいミャ！'.
voice_cards.address: Lamuness: 'ラムネス'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Keep a consistent tic: a sentence-final 'meow' or a 'mya' sound. Recommend 'mya' to match the JP ('Roger, mya!'), or blend 'me-' into words sparingly. Pick one rule and apply it to all ~170 lines. Otherwise prim and slightly nagging.

samples.jp: 観念するミャ、ラムネス。
samples.en: Give it up, Lamuness, mya.

samples.jp: マスコットはひどいミャ！ / これでもボクは５０００年以上生きてるミャ！
samples.en: Mascot?! How rude, mya! I'll have you know I've lived over 5,000 years, mya!

voice_cards.personality: Da Cider's snake-girl sidekick and flute-playing summoner of Queen Cideron. She is a fanatical cheerleader for her 'Darling', jealous of other women ('オバン'), and a ditzy rocker.
voice_cards.register_jp: ウチ; every sentence ends with じゃん / じゃ～ん; 'イエ～イ！', 'サイコーじゃん！　イカスじゃん！'.
voice_cards.tics: 'ダーリン、最高じゃ～ん！'; 'はいな！　ダーリン！'; 'オバンはいらないじゃん！'.
voice_cards.address: Da Cider: 'ダーリン'. Others: お前, given names.
voice_cards.english_guidance: A peppy groupie with a fixed tic. Render じゃん as a tag like '...y'know!' or a trademark interjection, applied consistently. Call Da Cider 'Darling'. Lots of 'Yeah!', 'Rockin'!', 'So cool!'.

samples.jp: イエ～イ！ / サイコーじゃん！　イカスじゃん！ / やっぱダーリンが一番カッコイイじゃん！
samples.en: Yeahhh! That's the best, y'know! So rockin', y'know! Darling's the coolest, y'know!

samples.jp: ヒマリなら許すじゃん♪ / オバンはいらないじゃん！
samples.en: Himari's okay, y'know~ But no old hags, y'know!

voice_cards.personality: Lamune's demonic villain and servant of Goburiki, revived in OE. He commands the Dark Dragon pirates and summons Da Cider. He is a pompous, booming tyrant.
voice_cards.register_jp: ワシ; archaic villain speech: ～じゃ/～である-ish, ～おる, ～ぬ, ～わ, ～よ, 貴様. Gloating laughter.
voice_cards.tics: 'ゴォキブリブリ、ゴブーリキ！' chant; 'ムハハハハハハ！'; 'ククク…'; '我が妖力の前に屈するがいいわ！'.
voice_cards.address: Da Cider: 'ダ・サイダー'; heroes: 貴様/貴様ら.
voice_cards.english_guidance: An old-school sorcerer-tyrant: archaic, rolling diction ('Kneel before my demonic might!', 'Fools!'). Keep the chant as nonsense incantation. Pompous rather than scary, but menacing in the climax.

samples.jp: ムハハハハハハ！ / 我が力の恐ろしさ身をもって知るがよい！
samples.en: MUHAHAHAHA! Learn the true terror of my power firsthand!

samples.jp: こ…この緊張感がない連中は一体なんなのだ！？ / このゴブーリキを馬鹿にすると痛い目を見るぞ！
samples.en: Wh-what is wrong with you people and your utter lack of tension?! Mock Goburiki and you will regret it!

voice_cards.jp: アデュー・ウォルサム
voice_cards.personality: Young knight of Earthtia, pilot of Ryu Knight Zephyr and self-styled 'Sonic Knight'. He is cheerful, rash, good-hearted and obsessed with the ideal of knighthood. Rival-turned-friend of Galden.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; energetic casual boy speech: ～ぜ, ～だぜ, ～だな, ～さ. Speaks of knightly duty with conviction.
voice_cards.tics: 'この音速の騎士、アデュー様が来たからには…'; 'ファイナル！ クラッシュ・ドォォォォン！！'; 'トルネード！ アタァァァック！'; 'ゼファー！ 俺に力を貸してくれえええっ！！'.
voice_cards.address: Paffy: 'パッフィー'; Galden: 'ガルデン'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Bright, brash fantasy-hero voice: plain modern English with a slight chivalric edge for knight-ideals ('A knight's place is on the front line!'). Shouted attack names in caps. Avoid medieval 'thee/thou'.

samples.jp: この音速の騎士、アデュー様が来たからには / もう好き勝手はさせないぜ！
samples.en: Now that the Sonic Knight, Adeu, is here, your fun's over!

samples.jp: 恨みや憎悪を糧にするなんて！ / お前は騎士の道を踏み外している！
samples.en: Feeding on grudges and hatred?! You've strayed from the path of a knight!

voice_cards.jp: パッフィー・パフリシア
voice_cards.personality: Princess of Pafuricia and a magic user (Ryu Mage Magidora). She is polite, regal and earnest, sometimes indignant, with a crush on Adeu that she denies.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; polite princess speech: ～ですわ, ～ですね, ～ませ, ～差し上げますわ. Emotional when flustered ('そ…そんなんじゃありません！').
voice_cards.tics: 'いきますわよ！'; 'ライダァァァス！' (spell); '私にだけ内緒にするなんて、ひどいです！'.
voice_cards.address: Adeu: 'アデュー'; others: さん.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Graceful and courteous: complete sentences, few contractions in formal moments, a gentle royal tone ('I shall...', 'Please, allow me'). Not stuffy, and flustered denials should be cute. Keep spell names as shouts.

samples.jp: アースティアの窮地に、パフリシアの王女として / ただ見ているなんてできませんわ。
samples.en: With Earthtia in peril, I cannot simply stand by as the princess of Pafuricia.

samples.jp: ですが魔法の氷や炎は一味違うということを / 教えて差し上げますわ！
samples.en: But allow me to show you that magical ice and fire are something else entirely!

voice_cards.personality: Former Dark Dragon Clan warrior and Adeu's ex-rival, now a stern ally who hunts Dark Dragon pirates (Rune Knight Steru). He is proud, aloof and philosophical about strength and honour.
voice_cards.register_jp: Mostly 私 in stern lines, 俺 with Adeu and friends; formal-archaic ～ぬ, ～ん, ～のだ, ～がいい, 貴様, ～せよ-like commands ('我に続け！'). Speaks in aphorisms.
voice_cards.tics: '空を切り裂く稲妻の光よ！ 我が剣に宿りたまえ！'; 'フッ'; '潔く私に討たれるがいい！'.
voice_cards.address: Adeu: 'アデュー' or 貴様 in teasing; enemies: 貴様.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Cool, formal, slightly archaic but readable ('Fall to my blade with honor.'). Few contractions. Proud, measured, dry humour ('Hmph. You've grown a little.'). His incantation can be grandiose.

samples.jp: 苦渋の道を越えた先にある栄光を信じ / ひたむきに歩む者こそが、真の強者としての誇りと / 尊敬を得られるのだ。
samples.en: Only one who walks on single-mindedly, trusting in the glory beyond the path of hardship, earns the pride and respect of the truly strong.

samples.jp: フッ、貴様も少しは成長したようだな。
samples.en: Hmph. It seems even you have grown a little.

voice_cards.personality: Banpresto's hot-headed Masoukishin pilot of Cybuster (wind), here as a guest. He is brash, kind-hearted and has a famously terrible sense of direction (his familiars needle him about it).
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; rough casual male speech: ～ぜ, ～だろ, ～ねぇ, てめぇ, ヘッ, つーか.
voice_cards.tics: 'ヘッ'; '風の魔装機神、サイバスター'; 'クロ、シロ、見せてやるよ、俺の本気を！！'; '方向音痴は関係ねぇだろ！'.
voice_cards.address: Shiro and Kuro: 'シロ', 'クロ'; enemies: てめぇ/おっさん.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Follow established SRW English Masaki: punchy, cocky, contractions, 'Heh' and banter. Snappy retorts about his directional sense. Keep 'Masoukishin' and 'Cybuster' as in SRW EN.

samples.jp: へへっ！　どうだい軍人さん。 / 風の魔装機神、サイバスターについて来られるかな？
samples.en: Heh heh! Whaddya say, soldier? Think you can keep up with Cybuster, the Masoukishin of Wind?

samples.jp: 方向音痴は関係ねぇだろ！ / つーか、そんなこと言ってる場合か！
samples.en: My sense of direction's got nothing to do with this! Besides, is this really the time?!

voice_cards.personality: Masaki's female black-cat familiar: the sensible, slightly prim one who gives technical readouts and scolds Masaki. (The input's 350 quotes appear to include the generic Guylos officer slot; Kuro's own quotes are about 14 and her dialogue 51 lines.)
voice_cards.register_jp: Feminine cat speech: な→ニャ ('ニャい', 'ニャんとか'), ～わよ, ～ニャ; precise system-status lines ('プラーニャ指数、限界値突破！').
voice_cards.tics: Cat-ified な-sounds (ニャ); 'マサキ、油断しちゃダメよ'; 'マサキ、調子に乗りすぎ！'; Prana puns ('プラーニャ').
voice_cards.address: Masaki: 'マサキ'; Shiro: 'シロ'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Follow SRW English treatment of the familiars: light cat puns ('meow' or 'nya' replacing 'now/no' sparingly, e.g. 'Nyo way!'), crisp instrument readouts, mild exasperation. Differentiate from Shiro by being more feminine and more technical.

samples.jp: マサキ、ここが正念場ニャ！
samples.en: Masaki, this is where it counts, nya!

samples.jp: 気をつけて、マサキ！ / あの荷電粒子砲は桁違いの破壊力ニャ！
samples.en: Careful, Masaki! That charged particle cannon packs a ridiculous punch, nya!

voice_cards.personality: The original Newtype ace and Gundam pilot. In this game he is the seasoned-but-still-young Amuro: polite, analytical, reluctant about killing but decisive in battle; an idealist who hopes humans and Mucus can understand each other.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕 (30x); polite です/ます to elders and officers (ブライトさん, セイラさん); plain casual speech to peers. Short exclamations in battle (なにっ！？, ああっ！).
voice_cards.tics: ガンダム、出ます！ = 'Gundam, launching!'; 見える！ = 'I can see it!'; 圧倒的じゃないか = 'It's overwhelming...!'.
voice_cards.address: ブライトさん = 'Bright' (or 'Captain Bright' in formal moments); セイラさん = 'Sayla'; Char = 'Char'; addresses Quattro as 'Lieutenant Bajeena' when formal.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Earnest, slightly soft-spoken young man. Use contractions; polite but not stiff toward Bright. In combat, clipped bursts ('I can see it!', 'Not yet!'). Avoid macho slang and swearing. No honorifics ('Sayla', not 'Sayla-san').

samples.jp: やります！ 相手がザクなら人間じゃないんだ！
samples.en: I'll do it! If it's a Zaku, there's no person in it!

samples.jp: ええ、理想論かもしれませんが 人もミューカスも変わっていけると信じたい…。
samples.en: Yeah... It may be idealistic, but I want to believe humans and the Mucus can both change.

voice_cards.personality: Cynical, wisecracking Guncannon pilot who complains constantly but comes through. Later a journalist type with a nose for conspiracies; streetwise commentator of the crew.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; very casual: ～だろ, ～じゃねぇか, ～のよね (mock-feminine teasing), drawn-out ねぇ/なぁ, slurred やれやれ, っての.
voice_cards.tics: やれやれ = 'Here we go again...' / 'Oh, brother.'; 冗談じゃない(ぜ) = 'You've gotta be kidding me.'; うへぇ = 'Ugh.'
voice_cards.address: セイラさん = 'Sayla' (flirty respect); ブライトさん = 'Bright' (mild sarcasm); Amuro/Hayato by name, お前.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Sarcastic, lazy drawl. Lots of contractions and slang ('gonna', 'ya', 'man'), rhetorical questions, sighs. Short punchy sentences. Never earnest for long; undercut drama with a quip. Avoid profanity stronger than 'damn'.

samples.jp: 冗談じゃない。 敵を攻撃すればミサイルが飛んで来るんだろ？ だったら早いとこ逃げちまおうぜ。
samples.en: No way. We hit them and missiles come flying, right? Then let's get outta here already.

samples.jp: よく言うぜ。 先にアクシズぶつけてきたのはそっちだろ！ 何かってえとデカブツ持ち出しやがって！
samples.en: Look who's talking! You're the ones who threw Axis at us first! Every time, you drag out some giant hunk of junk!

voice_cards.personality: Earnest, short judo-practicing Guntank pilot who wants to prove himself. Practical and dutiful, a bit of a worrier; calls for caution.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕 (to seniors), plain casual to peers; polite ～です/～ますよ to Kai and Sayla. Encouraging ～しましょう.
voice_cards.tics: Self-motivating cries: いくぞ…！ = 'Here goes!'; やってやる！ = 'I'll show them!'
voice_cards.address: カイさん = 'Kai'; セイラさん = 'Sayla'; Amuro by name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Sincere, slightly formal kid brother of the crew. Medium-length sentences, mild polite markers ('please', 'we should'). In battle, determined short lines. Avoid slang.

samples.jp: 大丈夫ですよ、カイさん。 コックピットを狙い撃つなんて方が難しいんだ。 そう簡単に当たりやしないさ。
samples.en: Relax, Kai. Hitting a cockpit dead-on is the hard part. They won't land a shot that easily.

samples.jp: いくぞ…！ ガンタンクが宇宙でもやれることを証明してやる！
samples.en: Here goes...! I'll prove the Guntank can fight in space too!

voice_cards.personality: White Base captain and, in this game, the fleet's main commander (737 lines). Stern, responsible, occasionally exasperated with hot-headed pilots, but deeply trusted. The voice of orders and briefings.
voice_cards.register_jp: Command register: plain imperatives (～しろ, 各機～せよ), ～だ/～だな; 私 in formal speech, 俺 rarely; formal です/ます when reporting to superiors or allies.
voice_cards.tics: Orders: 各機、発進！ = 'All units, launch!'; 全機、帰艦しろ！ = 'All units, return to the ship!'; くっ…勝手なことを！ = 'Damn it, acting on your own again!'
voice_cards.address: Calls everyone by bare name (アムロ, ジュドー, ミライ); クワトロ大尉 = 'Lieutenant Quattro'; 君 to newcomers.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Crisp military English: imperatives, no filler, 'All units', 'Hold position', 'Maximum speed'. Contractions OK in personal talk, fewer on the bridge. Exasperation through short bursts ('Judau, wait!'). Keep briefings clear and compact.

samples.jp: 各機、長引けば不利になる！ ホワイトベースの脱出ルートを優先しろ！
samples.en: All units, a drawn-out fight works against us! Prioritize securing White Base's escape route!

samples.jp: 待て、ジュドー！　これは罠だ！
samples.en: Wait, Judau! It's a trap!

voice_cards.personality: White Base's helmswoman: calm, gentle, mature, quietly perceptive. Mostly navigation reports and measured remarks.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; soft feminine plain speech (～わ, ～ね, ～かしら); polite reporting form on the bridge (～します, ～しました).
voice_cards.tics: Bridge reports: ホワイトベース、出航しました = 'White Base, departing.'; 了解 = 'Roger.'
voice_cards.address: ブライト (bare, intimate); ジュドー etc. by name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Calm, warm, measured. Navigation reports in concise standard phrasing ('Exiting the debris field.'). In personal lines, soft hedges ('I wonder...', 'don't you think?'). Avoid exclamation overuse.

samples.jp: 急ぎましょう。 何か嫌な予感がするわ。
samples.en: Let's hurry. I have a bad feeling about this.

samples.jp: 逃げ遅れた人が一人もいないということは 事前に計画された行動と見るべきね。
samples.en: Not a single person was left behind... We should assume this was planned in advance.

voice_cards.personality: Char's sister (Artesia), G-Fighter/Core Booster pilot. Aristocratic poise, cool, principled and sharp-tongued; later moves into business.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; refined feminine: ～わ, ～ね, ～なのではなくて？, ～よろしくて？, commanding おやめなさい！/さがりなさい！
voice_cards.tics: ～ではなくて？ = 'wouldn't you say?' (well-bred rhetorical); おやめなさい！ = 'Stop it!'
voice_cards.address: アムロ (bare); パオロ艦長 = 'Captain Paolo'; シャア大佐 = 'Captain Char' (coldly formal).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Elegant, composed, a touch imperious. Full sentences, few contractions in formal confrontations; rhetorical tags ('wouldn't you say?', 'is that understood?'). Commands short and regal. No slang.

samples.jp: シャア・アズナブルは死んだ…。 そういうことで、よろしくて？
samples.en: Char Aznable is dead. Shall we leave it at that?

samples.jp: さがりなさい！ この戦力で連邦本部に攻め込むなど自殺行為です！
samples.en: Stand down! Attacking Federation HQ with this force would be suicide!

voice_cards.personality: Amuro's childhood friend, now White Base communications operator. Caring, practical, cheerful; relays reports.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; polite operator speech (～です, ～とのことです, ～してください); casual ～ね/～わ with Amuro.
voice_cards.tics: Relay formula: ～とのことです = 'They report that...'; こちら、ホワイトベース = 'This is White Base.'
voice_cards.address: アムロ (bare, warm); ブライト艦長 = 'Captain Bright'; others with さん/君 -> drop to bare name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Clear radio-operator English ('Message from HQ:', 'All units, please return to the ship.'). Warm and simple in personal lines ('Good luck, Amuro!'). No jargon overload.

samples.jp: 偵察機より報告があります！ 北西に敵艦を確認、追尾中とのことです！
samples.en: Report from the recon plane! Enemy ship sighted to the northwest; they're tailing it!

samples.jp: 艦内に修理チームが待機してるわ。 危なくなったら戻ってきて。
samples.en: There's a repair team on standby. Come back if things get dangerous.

voice_cards.personality: White Base bridge operator: sensor and threat reports.
voice_cards.register_jp: Polite operator register (～です/～ます), clipped report nouns: 熱源反応多数！, 敵艦捕捉！
voice_cards.tics: Report formulas: ～を確認 = 'Confirmed...'; ～と推定 = 'estimated'.
voice_cards.address: ブライトさん = 'Captain' or 'Bright' (he calls him さん in 0079 style; use 'Captain' on duty).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Terse sensor-operator English: 'Multiple heat sources!', 'Enemy in range in three minutes!', 'Massive energy reading at the Mucus Gate!' Omit articles in urgent reports where natural. Keep consistent with Marker's phrasing.

samples.jp: ソーラ・レイの発射予測出ました！ 発射は８分後と推定！
samples.en: Solar Ray firing estimate is in! Projected to fire in eight minutes!

samples.jp: ミューカス・ゲートに高エネルギー反応！ 何か巨大なものが出てきます！
samples.en: High energy reading at the Mucus Gate! Something huge is coming out!

voice_cards.personality: White Base bridge operator, Oscar's counterpart; radar and target reports.
voice_cards.register_jp: Polite report register (～しました, ～と思われます), noun-heavy alerts.
voice_cards.tics: 敵の増援です！ = 'Enemy reinforcements!'; 針路クリア = 'Course clear.'
voice_cards.address: Addresses captain by rank/role.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Same as Oscar: terse, standard radar-operator phrasing ('Contact!', 'Course clear ahead of White Base!'). Slightly more analytical when explaining scans.

samples.jp: ホワイトベース前方、針路クリア！
samples.en: Course ahead of White Base is clear!

samples.jp: スキャンした結果ミューカスの反応は陽性です。 内部にミューカス・ゲートがあると思われます。
samples.en: The scan came back positive for Mucus. There's likely a Mucus Gate inside.

voice_cards.personality: The Red Comet, Zeon ace (1-Year War era Char in this game), ambitious, ironic, coolly charismatic, secretly scheming against the Zabis.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私 (45x); composed masculine plain speech (～だ, ～だな, ～とはな, ～まい); formal ～であります/～でしょうか to Kycilia; 君 to equals, 貴様 to enemies; private asides in parentheses.
voice_cards.tics: 見せてもらおうか、連邦のモビルスーツの性能とやらを！ = 'Let me see what this Federation mobile suit can do!'; 認めたくないものだな… = 'I'd rather not admit it...' (from 'the mistakes of one's youth'); ええい = 'Blast!' / 'Damn!'
voice_cards.address: キシリア様 = 'Lady Kycilia'; ガルマ = 'Garma' (君 = friendly 'you'); ドレン = 'Dren'; アムロ君 = 'Amuro'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Measured, urbane, faintly mocking. Prefer complete sentences, few contractions in formal speech, dry understatement ('Not bad...', 'I see.'). Sharp one-word curses only 'Blast!'. Asides in parentheses stay as internal monologue. Never sound hot-headed.

samples.jp: 理想だけでは戦争に勝てないのと同様に 理想だけで戦争を終わらせることはできん。
samples.en: Just as ideals alone cannot win a war, ideals alone cannot end one.

samples.jp: （フッ…ガルマ、君はいい友人だよ。 君の権限とコネを利用できるのは助かる）
samples.en: (Heh... Garma, you are a good friend. Your authority and connections are most useful to me.)

voice_cards.personality: Zeon commander of Odessa, aesthete and schemer devoted to Kycilia; condescending, sly, sore loser.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; haughty masculine plain speech with ～なのだよ, ～ではない, ～ぞ; polite ～ましょう/～ませんな to superiors (Dozle, Kycilia); フン.
voice_cards.tics: ジオンはあと１０年は戦える！ = 'Zeon can fight for another ten years!'; ～なのだよ = lecturing 'you see'.
voice_cards.address: キシリア様 = 'Lady Kycilia'; ガルマ様 = 'Lord Garma'; ドズル中将 = 'Vice Admiral Dozle'; トクワン大尉 = 'Lieutenant Tokwan'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Smug, precise, slightly theatrical. Uses 'you see', sniffs ('Hmph.'), dismissive comparisons. Fawning politeness to superiors, contempt downward. Moderate sentence length; no slang.

samples.jp: これは駆け引きなのだよ。
samples.en: This is a game of strategy, you see.

samples.jp: ふん、島国に似合いの小型機だな。 我がジオンのモビルスーツとは比べ物にならん。
samples.en: Hmph. A compact little machine, fitting for an island nation. It's no match for our Zeon mobile suits.

voice_cards.personality: Leader of the 08th MS Team: idealistic, hot-blooded, kind to subordinates, in love with Zeon's Aina Sahalin. Believes in people over flags.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺 (34x); straightforward masculine plain speech (～だ, ～ぞ, よぉぉし); polite 了解しました to superiors.
voice_cards.tics: Battle cry: 第０８ＭＳ小隊、攻撃開始！ = '08th MS Team, commence attack!'; よぉぉし = 'Alright!'
voice_cards.address: Team by bare name (ミケル, エレドア, カレン, サンダース); アイナ = 'Aina'; クリス中尉 = 'Lieutenant Chris' -> prefer 'Lieutenant Mackenzie'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Warm, energetic, earnest leader. Contractions, encouraging ('Good work, everyone.'), passionate declarations about Aina without irony. Avoid cynicism and heavy slang.

samples.jp: ジオンも連邦も関係ない！ そこで俺はアイナという人間に惚れたんだ！
samples.en: Zeon or Federation doesn't matter! What I fell for was Aina as a person!

samples.jp: ミケルとエレドアは特に疲れただろう。 今日はゆっくり休んでくれ。
samples.en: Michel, Eledore, you two must be especially worn out. Get some rest today.

voice_cards.personality: Veteran soldier once called the 'Grim Reaper' for outliving his teams; steady, protective, quietly guilt-ridden. The 08th's reliable sergeant.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; gruff, terse masculine speech (～だ, ～か…, ～ぞ); respectful ～です to Shiro (隊長).
voice_cards.tics: Radio check: こちらサンダース。北エリア異常なし = 'Sanders here. North area clear.'; もう誰も俺の目の前で死なせはしない = 'I won't let anyone else die in front of me.'
voice_cards.address: 隊長 = 'Chief' (Shiro); teammates by name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Laconic veteran: short declaratives, understated humor, soldier vocabulary. Few adjectives. Contractions natural. Avoid melodrama except in his 'no one dies' moments.

samples.jp: 脱走兵に敗残兵… 行き場をなくした連中の末路なんてそんなもんさ。
samples.en: Deserters, stragglers... That's how it ends for people with nowhere left to go.

samples.jp: もう誰も俺の目の前で死なせはしない！ シャトルはやらせんぞぉっ！
samples.en: I won't let anyone else die in front of me! You're not getting that shuttle!

voice_cards.personality: Tough, sardonic former nurse turned MS pilot of the 08th; tomboyish big-sister type, blunt but caring.
voice_cards.register_jp: あたし; rough feminine-neutral: ～だね, ～よ, ～さ, ～じゃないよ！, ～しな (imperative), あんた.
voice_cards.tics: なめんじゃないよ！ = 'Don't you dare underestimate me!'; Karen's 'GM head' gripes.
voice_cards.address: 隊長 = 'Chief' (often teasingly); others あんた = 'you'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Dry, tough, big-sisterly. Contractions, clipped commands ('Don't move!', 'Take a breather.'), sarcasm. Mild slang OK ('cut the whining'). No girlishness.

samples.jp: 泣き言を言うんじゃないよ！
samples.en: Cut the whining!

samples.jp: 動くのはよしな！ せっかく治療したのに傷口が開くよ！
samples.en: Don't move! You'll reopen the wound after I just patched you up!

voice_cards.personality: 08th MS Team's hover-truck sonar operator and wannabe musician; cocky, crude, loudmouthed but has a great ear.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; rough masculine slang: ～だぜ, ～やがる, ～じゃねぇか, いよう, おら, チッ.
voice_cards.tics: Sonar calls: 新たな音源を確認！ = 'New sound source detected!'; 俺はミュージシャンになるぜ！ = 'I'm gonna be a musician!'
voice_cards.address: 隊長(さん) = 'Chief' (cheeky); カレン, ミケル bare.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Brash, slangy, wisecracking. 'gonna', 'ya', 'hey', light swearing ('damn'). Short exclamations. Sonar reports technical but with attitude.

samples.jp: チッ、新たな音源を確認！ 伏兵がいやがったぜ！
samples.en: Tch, new sound source! There was an ambush waiting, damn it!

samples.jp: いよう、カレン！ ジム頭の調子はどうだ？
samples.en: Hey there, Karen! How's that GM head treating you?

voice_cards.personality: Youngest 08th member, hover-truck navigator; timid, polite, homesick for girlfriend B.B., sometimes panicky.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕 (9x); polite ～です/～ますよ to seniors; childish wails (うわぁぁあ！).
voice_cards.tics: 隊長！ appeals; Ｂ．Ｂ． = 'B.B.'
voice_cards.address: 隊長 = 'Chief'; エレドアさん = 'Eledore'; カレンさん = 'Karen'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Nervous, polite youngster. Softeners ('um', 'but, Chief...'), questions, whining when scared. Contractions fine; no swearing.

samples.jp: うわぁぁあ！ ホバートラックの火力じゃ モビルスーツに対抗するなんて無理ですよぉ！
samples.en: Waaah! There's no way a hover truck's guns can take on a mobile suit!

samples.jp: 僕はＢ．Ｂ．の待つ地球に帰るんだ！ 絶対に死ぬもんか！
samples.en: B.B.'s waiting for me back on Earth! There's no way I'm dying here!

voice_cards.jp: クリスチーナ・マッケンジー
voice_cards.personality: Federation test pilot of the Gundam 'Alex', neighbor of Al and unknowing friend of Bernie. Kind, mature, honest, with a capable officer's resolve.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私 (also あたし casually); feminine plain speech (～わ, ～ね, ～よ, ～かしら); firm commands to enemies (投降しなさい！).
voice_cards.tics: Address: ちょっと、バーニィ = 'Hey, Bernie'.
voice_cards.address: バーニィ = 'Bernie'; アル = 'Al'; フラウ by name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Warm, grounded young woman. Natural contractions, light wry humor, measured tactical observations. Firm in battle. Avoid girlish fillers.

samples.jp: 相手が強いか弱いかで戦うんじゃない。 守りたい何かがあるから人は戦えるのよ！
samples.en: We don't fight because the enemy is strong or weak. People can fight because there's something they want to protect!

samples.jp: 速すぎて恐いくらいよ…。 こんな敏感な機体、実戦で使えるの？
samples.en: It's so fast it's almost scary... Can a machine this sensitive even be used in real combat?

voice_cards.personality: Supreme Commander of Zeon: brilliant, cold, contemptuous of weakness, a demagogue who believes in natural selection.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; authoritative plain speech (～だ, ～ん (negation), ～ねばならん), oratorical; polite ～ます/～ですな only to his father.
voice_cards.tics: あえて言おう！ = 'I say it outright!' (cf. 'I'll say it plainly: they are trash'); 圧倒的じゃないか、我が軍は = 'Our forces are overwhelming!'; フッ.
voice_cards.address: 父上 = 'Father'; キシリア, ガルマ bare.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Imperious, rhetorical, cold. Long balanced sentences in speeches, curt dismissals elsewhere. No contractions in speeches; few in private. Words like 'weak', 'cull', 'the species'. Never emotional except contempt.

samples.jp: 種の存続のためには 惰弱なものは淘汰されねばならん。
samples.en: For the survival of the species, the weak must be culled.

samples.jp: あえて言おう！ 信念なき者に未来を語る資格などない！
samples.en: I say it outright! Those without conviction have no right to speak of the future!

voice_cards.personality: Zeon Rear Admiral, head of intelligence and the Mobile Assault Force; cunning, imperious, pragmatic; here commanding the Orthros unit.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; masculine-leaning command speech (～だ, ～せよ, ～であろう, ～ぞ), clipped うむ; polite ～ですか/～ます to Gihren.
voice_cards.tics: ええい！ = 'Blast!'; うむ = 'Very well.'
voice_cards.address: 父上 = 'Father'; ゼクス特尉 = 'Lieutenant Zechs'; シャア大佐 = 'Captain Char'; 諸君 = 'all of you'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Cold, regal, terse. Imperatives, no contractions in orders, measured threats. 'Very well.' 'Is that so?' Avoid feminine softness; she speaks like a commander.

samples.jp: 父上のことだ。 負けられぬ戦いと知り、兵の士気を高めるため 自ら望んで前線に出たのであろう。
samples.en: That is just like Father. Knowing this battle cannot be lost, he must have gone to the front himself to raise the troops' morale.

samples.jp: 臨戦態勢を解除する。 交代で兵を休ませよ。
samples.en: Stand down from combat readiness. Let the troops rest in shifts.

voice_cards.personality: Zeon technical officer obsessed with his Apsalus and restoring House Sahalin; sickly, fanatical, theatrical, increasingly unhinged.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; grandiose archaic-tinged speech (～せしめる, ～ねばならぬ, ～わ, フフフ, フハハハ), 貴様.
voice_cards.tics: Manic laughter フフフ… / フハハハハ = 'Heh heh heh...' / 'Ha ha ha!'; アプサラス constantly.
voice_cards.address: アイナ = 'Aina' (sister); enemies 貴様.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Florid villain English: 'judgment', 'the House of Sahalin', 'from the depths of hell'. Long exclamatory sentences, archaic flavor ('I shall'), laughter. No contractions in tirades.

samples.jp: フフフ…見たか、アプサラスの力を！ 貴様らの頭上から裁きの鉄槌を下してやる！
samples.en: Heh heh heh... Behold the power of the Apsalus! I shall bring the hammer of judgment down upon your heads!

samples.jp: 貴様だけは生かしてはおけぬ！ サハリン家の純潔を汚した貴様だけは 我が手で直接葬り去らねば気が晴れぬわ！
samples.en: You alone I cannot allow to live! You who defiled the purity of House Sahalin! I will not rest until I bury you with my own hands!

voice_cards.personality: Emotionless-seeming Gundam pilot/operative; mission-focused, laconic, but with a strong moral core ('I won't kill anymore').
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; blunt plain speech, noun-phrase reports (目標確認。, 任務了解。), ～だ/～する; 貴様/お前.
voice_cards.tics: 任務了解 = 'Mission accepted.'; お前を殺す = 'I'll kill you.'; 任務続行 = 'Continuing mission.'
voice_cards.address: Bare names (ゼクス, 刹那); 貴様 to enemies.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Ultra-terse. Fragmentary report style ('Target confirmed. Destroying it.'), flat tone, no exclamation spam, no fillers, rarely contractions. Long lines only for rare philosophical statements.

samples.jp: 目標確認。 ただちに破壊する。
samples.en: Target confirmed. Destroying it immediately.

samples.jp: 俺は何人も殺してきた。 だが、もう俺は殺さない。 無用に命を奪うお前とは違う！
samples.en: I've killed many people. But I won't kill anymore. I'm not like you, taking lives for no reason!

voice_cards.personality: Celestial Being's Gundam Meister, a former child soldier seeking to end war; serious, blunt, few words, gradually more open.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; terse plain speech, military jargon (目標を駆逐する, セカンドフェーズに移行する), ～だ, 貴様.
voice_cards.tics: 刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ、～ = 'Setsuna F. Seiei, ...!'; 目標を駆逐する = 'Eliminating target!'; 歪み = 'distortion'.
voice_cards.address: Bare names everyone (アムロ too); 貴様 to enemies.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Short, flat, declarative; mission-speak ('Moving to second phase.'). Keyword 'distortion' for 歪み. Avoid contractions in battle statements; no slang or humor.

samples.jp: エクシア、目標ポイントに到達。 これよりセカンドフェーズに移行する。
samples.en: Exia, target point reached. Moving to the second phase.

samples.jp: 守りたいものがある。終わらせたい戦いがある。 だから俺は、お前達を倒す！
samples.en: There are things I want to protect. Wars I want to end. That's why I'll defeat you!

voice_cards.personality: King of Hearts of the Shuffle Alliance, martial artist hunting DG Cells; hot-blooded, gruff, honorable, matured into a mentor figure here.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺 (69x); rough masculine (～だ, ～ぞ, ～か！, ～してもらう), shouted battle chants with long vowels; あんた to some adults.
voice_cards.tics: ガンダムファイト！ レディィィ・ゴォォォッ！！ = 'Gundam Fight! Ready... GO!!'; キング・オブ・ハートの名にかけて！ = 'In the name of the King of Hearts!'; 流派！東方不敗の名のもとにぃ！ = 'In the name of the Undefeated of the East!'; 明鏡止水.
voice_cards.address: 師匠 = 'Master'; others bare name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Bold, shouty, sincere. Short exclamations in battle, chant-style lines with '!!'. Plain words, martial vocabulary ('fist', 'spirit', 'soul'). Contractions in casual talk. No modern slang.

samples.jp: 終わらせてやる！　戦いも！　お前の野望も！ このキング・オブ・ハートの名にかけて！
samples.en: I'll end it! This battle! Your ambitions! In the name of the King of Hearts!

samples.jp: 人間の暗い感情を喰らうと言ったな！ 愛も怒りも悲しみも超えた、俺の明鏡止水の心 喰えるものなら喰ってみろ！
samples.en: You said you feed on humanity's dark emotions! My heart of Meikyo Shisui has transcended love, anger and sorrow. Devour it if you can!

voice_cards.jp: バーナード・ワイズマン
voice_cards.personality: Young Zeon rookie pilot of the Cyclops Team who befriends Al and Chris; boyish, warm, insecure, later resolves to stand his ground.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; casual young male speech (～さぁ, ～だろ, ～かい？), polite はい/です to his commander.
voice_cards.tics: Self-deprecation: また、隊長に怒られちまう = 'The Chief's gonna chew me out again...'
voice_cards.address: クリス, アル bare; 隊長 = 'Captain' (Steiner).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Friendly, a bit sheepish everyman. Contractions, casual 'hey', 'y'know'. Earnest at key moments. Avoid tough-guy talk.

samples.jp: クリスがさぁ、俺のこと何かしゃべってなかった？
samples.en: Hey, so... did Chris say anything about me?

samples.jp: いや、これも自分で選んだ道なんだ！ 俺はもう逃げたりしない！
samples.en: No, this is the path I chose for myself! I'm not running away anymore!

voice_cards.jp: アルフレッド・イズルハ
voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school boy from Libot who idolizes Bernie; curious, naive, emotional.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕; childish casual speech (～だよね？, ～の？, ～なんだぁ, うん！).
voice_cards.tics: Breathless questions and exclamations.
voice_cards.address: バーニィ = 'Bernie'; クリス = 'Chris'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Simple, childlike English: short sentences, questions, 'really?', 'wow'. No complex vocabulary.

samples.jp: バーニィはいいヤツなんだ。 だから友達になったんだ。
samples.en: Bernie's a good guy. That's why we became friends.

samples.jp: 本当に…本当に戻ってきてくれたんだね。
samples.en: You really... you really came back.

voice_cards.personality: Neo Zeon commander (Zaku III), proud warrior who loves battle, gruff and confident, mentor-handler of Ple Two.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私 mostly, 俺 when heated; commanding masculine (～しろ, ～だな, ～わっ！), contemptuous 甘いな.
voice_cards.tics: 甘いな/甘いわっ！ = 'Too slow!' / 'Naive!'; このラカン・ダカラン = 'I, Rakan Dahkaran...'
voice_cards.address: プルツー bare; enemies 貴様.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Bluff, confident officer. Short commands, taunts ('Too soft!'), occasional wry approval. Mild archaic grandeur in rage. Few contractions in orders.

samples.jp: ここが貴様の墓場だ！ 宇宙の塵となれ！
samples.en: This is your grave! Become stardust!

samples.jp: プルツー、お前の読みどおりだな。 さすがはニュータイプだ。
samples.en: Just as you predicted, Ple Two. Spoken like a true Newtype.

voice_cards.personality: Masked OZ ace (Milliardo Peacecraft), here a Zeon-attached 'special lieutenant' in Kycilia's Orthros unit; chivalrous, proud, philosophical, seeks worthy duels.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私 (37x); refined masculine (～だ, ～ではない, ～か); formal ～です/～ます to superiors; 貴様 to rivals, 君 to respected others.
voice_cards.tics: このトールギスをもってしても = 'Even with this Tallgeese...'; 見くびってもらっては困るな = 'Don't underestimate me.'
voice_cards.address: ヒイロ・ユイ (full name, intense); シャア bare; キシリア to her face formally.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Noble, elegant knight. Complete sentences, measured cadence, honor vocabulary ('duel', 'conviction'). Few contractions. Taunts courteous, never crude.

samples.jp: トールギスと私を見くびってもらっては困るな！
samples.en: Do not underestimate the Tallgeese or me!

samples.jp: 伝わってくる憎悪と苦痛…。 ミューカスにとっては我々こそが侵略者か。
samples.en: Hatred and pain, flowing toward me... To the Mucus, perhaps we are the invaders.

voice_cards.personality: Ultimate Coordinator and Strike Freedom pilot, representing the colonies; gentle, pacifist, firm against needless fighting.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕 (52x); polite ～です/～ください to strangers/enemies, soft casual ～だね/～よ to friends; pleading やめてください！
voice_cards.tics: Launch: ストライクフリーダム、キラ・ヤマト…いきます！ = 'Strike Freedom, Kira Yamato, launching!'
voice_cards.address: アスラン bare; enemies あなた (polite 'you').
voice_cards.english_guidance: Gentle, sincere, pleading. Polite toward enemies ('Please stop this!'), questions appealing to conscience. Contractions in casual talk. Avoid aggression and slang.

samples.jp: そんな風に他人を否定して どんな明日が手に入るって言うんですか！？
samples.en: What kind of tomorrow do you think you'll get by rejecting others like that!?

samples.jp: 僕は強すぎる力の代償を知っている。 だから…あなたを必ず止める！
samples.en: I know the price of having too much power. That's why... I will stop you, no matter what!

voice_cards.personality: Infinite Justice pilot, Kira's friend and Shinn's former mentor; serious, responsible, reserved, analytical.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; steady masculine plain speech (～だ, ～だろう, ～するな！), measured.
voice_cards.tics: Warnings: 気をつけろ！ = 'Be careful!'; 油断するな！ = 'Don't let your guard down!'
voice_cards.address: キラ, シン bare (big-brother tone).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Composed, earnest. Clear sentences, tactical analysis, mentor praise ('You've grown, Shinn.'). Contractions OK. No slang.

samples.jp: 成長したな、シン。 そういう冷静さは大事だ。
samples.en: You've grown, Shinn. That kind of composure is important.

samples.jp: 敵の戦力を見極めずに先走りすぎだぞ！
samples.en: You're rushing ahead without gauging the enemy's strength!

voice_cards.personality: Graham Aker in a samurai mask, obsessed with defeating the Gundam; theatrical, chivalric, grandiloquent, mixes faux-samurai and Western flourishes.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; stilted archaic-heroic (～ぬ, ～であろう, ～か, 承知した, 以後、お見知りおきを), katakana loanwords (センチメンタリズム), addresses Setsuna as 少年.
voice_cards.tics: 会いたかったぞ、ガンダム！/少年！ = 'I've longed to see you, Gundam!' / '...boy!'; あえて言おう…遺憾であると！ = 'I'll say it outright... I find this regrettable!'; 承知した = 'Understood.'
voice_cards.address: 少年 = 'boy' (Setsuna); 少女よ = 'girl'; enemies 貴様.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Over-the-top, formal, pompous with sincere passion. No contractions; archaic touches ('Know this!', 'Have at you!'); occasional Western-loanword flourish ('sentimentalism'). Never casual.

samples.jp: 会いたかった…！ 会いたかったぞ、少年！
samples.en: I've longed... I've longed to see you, boy!

samples.jp: 確かに私は日本の武士ではない。 だが、私の太刀筋には武士道の魂が宿っている！
samples.en: True, I am no Japanese samurai. But the soul of bushido dwells in my swordsmanship!

voice_cards.personality: Neo Zeon leader of Axis: commanding, proud, icy, contemptuous of the Federation and 'vulgarians', with lingering feelings for Char.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; masculine command register (～だ, ～か, ～せん, ～ではない), 貴様; deferential はっ、総帥 to Gihren.
voice_cards.tics: 俗物がっ！ = 'You vulgarian!'; 当たりはせんよ = 'You won't hit me.'; フフフ.
voice_cards.address: シャア bare (charged); ジュドー bare; プル、プルツー; ハマーン様 is how others address her ('Lady Haman').
voice_cards.english_guidance: Regal, cold, cutting. No contractions in pronouncements, short contemptuous retorts, elevated vocabulary ('insolence', 'vulgar'). Emotion only toward Char/Judau.

samples.jp: 気安いな！ 戦場で敵と慣れ合う気は…ない！
samples.en: Don't be so familiar! I have no intention of fraternizing with the enemy on the battlefield!

samples.jp: 筋違いだな。 私は宇宙の民の怨念を背負ってここにいる。 ここで退くような真似はできん！
samples.en: You misunderstand. I stand here bearing the grudges of all spacenoids. I cannot simply retreat!

voice_cards.personality: Junk-dealer kid from Shangri-La turned ZZ pilot; brash, cheeky, street-smart, kind-hearted, devoted to sister Leina.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; very casual teen slang (～じゃないの, ～でしょ？, ～だよ, こなくそっ！, ～ってこと), あんた to adults including Haman.
voice_cards.tics: こなくそっ！ = 'Take that, dammit!' / 'You little...!'; ラカンのおっさん = 'old man Rakan'.
voice_cards.address: リィナ, プル bare; ブライト艦長/ブライトさん = 'Captain Bright'/'Bright'; ハマーン bare.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Cocky, fast, slangy teen. Contractions, 'ya', 'man', taunts, rhetorical questions. Quick humor even in danger. Mild swearing only ('damn').

samples.jp: こなくそっ！ 足がないのに強いじゃないの！
samples.en: Dammit! Pretty tough for a guy with no legs!

samples.jp: ハマーン、こんな戦争はやめて あんたはその才能を人類のために活かすべきだ！
samples.en: Haman, stop this war! You should use that talent of yours for humanity!

voice_cards.personality: Judau's sensible, prim little sister; scolds her brother, polite to adults, wants him to study or get a real job.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; polite to adults (～ます, 皆さん), bossy feminine to Judau (～でしょ！, ～わよ！, ダメよ！, …んもう).
voice_cards.tics: お兄ちゃん！ (constant)
voice_cards.address: お兄ちゃん = 'Judau' / 'big brother' (prefer 'Judau' or 'bro' sparingly; brief bans honorific suffixes, but 'big brother' is a translation).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Prim, scolding little sister. Short reproachful lines, 'Honestly!', polite apologies to adults. Contractions fine.

samples.jp: ほら、お兄ちゃん！ きちんと謝らないとダメでしょ！
samples.en: Come on, Judau! You have to apologize properly!

samples.jp: ダメよ！ 人間、勉強するか働くかしないとダメになるわよ！
samples.en: No way! People go to waste if they don't either study or work!

voice_cards.personality: Childlike Neo Zeon Newtype (Qubeley) who latches onto Judau, defects to the heroes; playful, clingy, cheerful, can be petulant or scared.
voice_cards.register_jp: あたし (49x); childish casual (～だよ, ～もん, ～だぁ, ～ないの？, やだぁ), drawn vowels.
voice_cards.tics: あたしだって、できるもん！ = 'I can do it too!'; ジュドー! ; お兄ちゃん for Judau sometimes.
voice_cards.address: ジュドー bare (adoring); プルツー; ハマーン bare.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Bubbly little-girl English: short, sing-song, whiny when upset ('No fair!'). Simple vocabulary, exclamations, cute but not baby talk.

samples.jp: やだぁ、遊んでくれないの？ じゃあ、もういらない！　帰って！
samples.en: Aww, you won't play with me? Then I don't want you! Go home!

samples.jp: ゴメンね、ハマーン。 あたしはジュドーと一緒に戦うって決めたんだ。
samples.en: Sorry, Haman. I've decided to fight alongside Judau.

voice_cards.personality: Ple's clone, conditioned Cyber-Newtype (Qubeley Mk-II); cold, aggressive, arrogant, unstable under mental strain.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私 (47x); masculine-tough speech (～だ！, ～しな, ～かい？, ～よ！), 貴様/お前; pained ううっ.
voice_cards.tics: 私はプルツーだ！ = 'I am Ple Two!'; オールドニュータイプは失せな！ = 'Get lost, old Newtype!'
voice_cards.address: ハマーン様 = 'Lady Haman'; ラカン bare; enemies お前.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Snarling, cocky, clipped. Taunts, commands, contempt; under stress, broken fragments ('My head... it hurts!'). Contractions natural. Contrast clearly with Ple's cuteness.

samples.jp: その名前を呼ぶな！　私はプルツーだ！
samples.en: Don't call me that! I'm Ple Two!

samples.jp: やめろ…私を不愉快にさせるなぁぁぁ！
samples.en: Stop it... Stop making me sick!

voice_cards.personality: Destiny pilot, hot-tempered war orphan driven to protect lives; impulsive, intense, gradually calmer and respectful.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; rough young male speech (～てやる！, ～させない！, 黙れ！), polite ～です/～ますよ to seniors (Athrun, Kira, Kiriko); あんた to enemies.
voice_cards.tics: 運命を切り開く！ = 'I'll carve out my own destiny!' (plays on Destiny).
voice_cards.address: アスラン/キラ (seniors, polite); キリコさん, ダバさん = 'Kiriko', 'Daba'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Hot, aggressive in battle ('I'll smash every last one of you!'), short shouts. Polite and slightly awkward with seniors. Contractions. Avoid heavy profanity.

samples.jp: こいつら…まとめて叩き潰してやる！
samples.en: You bastards... I'll crush you all at once!

samples.jp: 本当にいいんですか？ このままコネクト・フォースを抜けてしまって…。
samples.en: Are you really okay with this? Just leaving the Connect Force like that...?

voice_cards.personality: Sensitive, hot-tempered Zeta Gundam pilot with strong Newtype empathy; idealistic, quick to anger at injustice, respectful but outspoken.

In English its official title is "Zoids: Chaotic Century", the name on the Viz Media license and the US/Australian Cartoon Network broadcasts. "Zoids: Guardian Force" is only an on-screen/broadcast label for the second half (eps 27-67, after the time skip), and the Zoids Wiki treats it as a sub-arc of Chaotic Century. OE mixes both halves (Prozen, Rosso and Viola, Mt. Ossa from the first; Hiltz, Thomas, Death Stinger, Ultrasaurus and the Guardian Force itself from the second), so the umbrella title fits. voice_cards.personality: The hot-blooded, good-natured teenage hero of Chaotic Century and the de facto lead of the Zoids cast in OE. He is impulsive, honest and stubborn, loves his Liger and Zeke like family, and is protective of Fiona. He is quick to make friends (he adopts Ruuji as his "Liger Combo" partner) and never backs away from Raven.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺 / 俺達. Casual boyish male speech: ～ぜ, ～さ, ～だろ, ～じゃねぇか, slurred ねぇ/すっげぇ/腹減っちまった. Never polite, except a few plain ああ/わかってる answers.
voice_cards.tics: いくぜ！ / いくぞ、ライガー！ ("Let's go, Liger!"); 負けねえ…俺は誰にも負けねえ！; food-related lines (メシにしようぜ！); すっげぇ！ ("Whoa!", "Awesome!").
voice_cards.address: Fiona -> "Fiona" (protective, gentle); Zeke -> "Zeke" or "buddy"; Raven -> "Raven" (rival, shouted); Irvine and Moonbay by name; Thomas -> "Thomas"; Herman -> "Herman" or "Colonel" (informal); Dr. D -> "Doc".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Short, punchy, heavy on contractions ("gonna", "gotta" sparingly; "c'mon" is fine). Use exclamations like "Whoa!", "Alright!", "No way!". Keep the vocabulary simple and earnest with no sarcasm. He's cocky but sincere, the dub's bright teen-hero voice. Avoid profanity beyond "darn" or "jeez" and avoid slangy 2020s idioms.

samples.jp: メシにしようぜ！ 俺、腹減っちまったよぉ！
samples.en: Let's eat! I'm starving!

voice_cards.jp: フィーネ・エレシーヌ・リネ
voice_cards.personality: An amnesiac Ancient Zoidian girl found sleeping in ruins. She is gentle, innocent and slowly learns human emotions through Van. She has an empathic link with Zoids, senses danger, and is central to the Zoid Eve and Death Saurer plot.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私 / 私達. Soft feminine speech: ～わ, ～の, ～よ; frequent ellipses and fragments (一緒に行く…。). Polite to elders (はい！ 皆さんもお元気で). Short, halting sentences, especially early on.
voice_cards.tics: Ellipsis-heavy, childlike questions (トモダチって…何？). Utters warnings about Zoids' feelings (このゾイドも何か変…). Calls the Death Saurer 悪魔の化身.
voice_cards.address: Van -> "Van" (her closest bond); Zeke -> "Zeke"; Moonbay, Irvine by name; Thomas -> "Thomas".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Simple vocabulary, gentle tone, few contractions in her more mystic lines but natural ones in casual talk. Keep the ellipses and fragments ("I'll go too..."). Avoid slang and sarcasm. Prophetic lines can be slightly formal ("It will bring an end to Planet Zi").

samples.jp: バン…トモダチって…何？
samples.en: Van... what is a "friend"?

samples.jp: 私に怒ることも、泣くことも そして、一緒に笑うことも… 全部バンが教えてくれたわ。

voice_cards.personality: Van's silver Organoid. A loyal, expressive animal partner who fuses with Van's Liger. He has no words, only growls and whimpers.

voice_cards.tics: Growls of different intensity; a high キュウゥ for distress or affection.
voice_cards.address: N/A.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Render as English growl onomatopoeia and keep the intensity scale: "Grrr...", "Grraaah!", "Grooo...", "Kyuu!" (whine), "Rrr?". Keep them short. Don't translate them into words. Match the punctuation (? = curious growl).

samples.jp: グオォォォ！
samples.en: Grraaaah!

samples.jp: グオォ？
samples.en: Grrr?

voice_cards.personality: A cool, cynical mercenary and Command Wolf pilot with an eyepatch. He starts out as a bounty-chasing rival and becomes the gruff big brother of the team. Pragmatic and money-minded, but loyal.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺. Rough adult male: ～じゃねぇか, ～ぜ, ～だろ, ～やがって, てめぇ, しょうがねぇなぁ. Calls Dr. D 爺さん. Ironic ほう/へっ.
voice_cards.tics: しょうがねぇなぁ ("Can't be helped"); チッ ("Tch"); へっ; 相棒 ("partner") for his Zoid and allies.
voice_cards.address: Moonbay -> "Moonbay" (bickering partners); Van -> "kid" or "Van"; Dr. D -> "old man"; Thomas -> "Lieutenant" (teasing); Karl -> "Schubaltz".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Laconic, dry, wry. Lots of contractions, some rough words ("damn" is okay in moderation). Short sentences with a sardonic edge ("Figures." "Tch, cocky bastards..."). He never gushes, and his warmth shows through deadpan humor.
