voice_cards.personality: A brash, money-loving transporter ("運び屋") who drives a Gustav and is a former speed racer. She is loud, mercenary on the surface and warm underneath, and is often the comic relief. Has a running bicker with Irvine.
voice_cards.register_jp: あたし. Lively tough-girl speech: ～よ, ～ね, ～じゃない！, ～だよ, ～だからねえ; exclamations うっひょぉぉ, あいよ！ Sometimes switches to mock-polite (～ますよ).
voice_cards.tics: Theme song: あたしは～荒野の～運び屋さ～♪ ("I'm the transporter of the wasteland~♪"). 運び屋ムンベイ; ここからは別料金だからねえ！ ("That'll cost extra!"); 根性見せろぉぉ！
voice_cards.address: Irvine -> "Irvine" (exasperated); Van -> "Van" (big-sister tone); Fiona -> "Fiona"; Louise -> "Madam President".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Breezy, sassy, fast. Money jokes, "hon" or "kid" occasionally, lots of exclamation marks and interjections ("Whoa-ho!", "You got it!"). Contractions throughout. Keep the song lines as sing-song with a ~ or a musical note (the ♪ glyph exists in CP932).

samples.jp: あたしは～荒野の～運び屋さ～♪
samples.en: I'm the trans~porter of the waste~land~♪

samples.jp: ここからは別料金だからねえ！
samples.en: From here on, it's extra!

voice_cards.personality: Rosso's partner in the Desert Arcobaleno band. A tough, confident woman pilot and ex-Imperial soldier who later sides with the heroes and guards young Emperor Rudolph.
voice_cards.register_jp: Mixed 私 / あたし. Assertive, slightly sly feminine speech: ～わね, ～じゃないか, ～だね, ～かい？. Commanding in battle (早く行って！).
voice_cards.tics: フフッ; チッ、あたしとしたことが！ ("Tch, how careless of me!"); くらいな！ ("Take this!").
voice_cards.address: Rosso -> "Rosso" (partner); Van -> "Van" or "boy"; Rudolph by name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Cool, worldly, a little teasing. Medium-length lines with contractions. A gang-veteran tone ("Looks like we owe you one."). Avoid girlish exclamations.

samples.jp: チッ、あたしとしたことが！
samples.en: Tch, sloppy of me!

samples.jp: どうやら、あんたらに借りができたみたいね。
samples.en: Looks like we owe you one.

voice_cards.personality: A Helic Republic Colonel, the honorable and dependable commander who first recruits Van and later commands the Ultrasaurus. Earnest and a little stiff, he is the son of President Louise.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私 in official mode, 俺 when relaxed. Military commands: ～しろ！, ～するんだ！, 了解しました. Polite to the President (～しましょう).
voice_cards.tics: Rally lines: 最後の最後まで…あきらめるな！; ウルトラザウルス、発進だ！ ("Ultrasaurus, move out!").
voice_cards.address: Van -> "Van"; Louise -> "Madam President" (in public; she slips into "Rob"); Moonbay by name; Dr. D -> "Doctor".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Clear military English: crisp orders ("All units, secure the Ultrasaurus's path!"), "Roger", "Understood". Fewer contractions in orders, natural ones in personal talk. Upright and warm, never crude.

samples.jp: ウルトラザウルス、発進だ！
samples.en: Ultrasaurus, move out!

samples.jp: 最後の最後まで…あきらめるな！
samples.en: Don't give up... not until the very end!

voice_cards.personality: An eccentric, excitable Zoid scientist who joins Van's group. He mixes old-man rambling with technical exposition about Zoid cores, the Gravity Cannon and ancient ruins, and is the main explainer of Zoids lore in OE.
voice_cards.register_jp: ワシ. Old-man yakuwarigo: ～じゃ, ～じゃろう, ～のう, ～おる, ～わい, いかん！, フム.
voice_cards.tics: フム ("Hmm"); いかん！ ("No good!", "Look out!"); a scientist's enthusiasm.
voice_cards.address: Van -> "Van" or "my boy"; Lloyd -> "Lord Lloyd" (respect, fellow scientist); Rudolph -> "Your Highness".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Render the old-man dialect with grandfatherly English, not a fake accent: "Hmm, I see", "my boy", "Bah!", "I daresay", "Oh-ho!". Expository lines should stay clear and slightly long-winded. Avoid "ye olde" archaisms.

samples.jp: いかん！　逃げろ、バン！
samples.en: No good! Run, Van!

samples.jp: あれが古の伝説に残る 破滅の魔獣…デスザウラーか…。
samples.en: So that's the Beast of Destruction of ancient legend... the Death Saurer...

voice_cards.jp: ルイーズ・テレサ・キャムフォード
voice_cards.personality: President of the Helic Republic. Calm, principled and diplomatic, she favors peace with the Empire and targets Prozen rather than the Guylos people. She is Rob Herman's mother.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私 / 私達. Formal, polite feminine speech: です/ます, ～でしょう, ～ください, ご冗談でしょう. Occasional plain ～わ in private.
voice_cards.tics: Restrained exclamations: なんてこと…。; 無条件降伏？ ご冗談でしょう。
voice_cards.address: Rob -> "Colonel Herman" (she corrects herself from "Rob"); Prozen -> "Marshal Prozen"; Connect Force members -> formal "you".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Measured presidential register: complete sentences, few contractions, diplomatic vocabulary ("I will hear your demands."). Dignified rather than cold.

samples.jp: 無条件降伏？　ご冗談でしょう。
samples.en: Unconditional surrender? Surely you jest.

samples.jp: ロブは…いえ、ハーマン大佐は うまくやってくれているようですね。
samples.en: Rob... I mean, Colonel Herman seems to be handling things well.

voice_cards.jp: ルドルフ・ゲアハルト・ツェッペリンⅢ世
voice_cards.personality: The young heir and later Emperor of the Guylos Empire. Kind and earnest, he is kidnapped and protected by Van and later Rosso. He has to grow into a ruler who opposes Prozen.
voice_cards.register_jp: Switches register: 私 and formal です/ます or imperial edicts (～を命じます) in public; 僕 and boyish polite speech among friends. A childish outburst when captured (放せ、放すのだぁ！).
voice_cards.tics: Calls Karl シュバルツ先生 ("Mr. Schubaltz"/"Sir"); shouts バァァァン！
voice_cards.address: Van -> "Van"; Rosso -> "Mr. Rosso"; Karl -> "Colonel Schubaltz" or "Sir"; Dr. D -> "Dr. D".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Two voices: formal proclamations ("I hereby order the immediate cessation of...") and a polite, eager boy elsewhere ("Mr. Rosso! I'm over here!"). Use few contractions in imperial mode and keep it simple and sincere in boy mode.

samples.jp: 本日、午前１１時。 祖父、ツェッペリンⅡ世皇帝陛下は 崩御あそばされました。
samples.en: At 11 a.m. today, my grandfather, His Majesty Emperor Zeppelin II, passed away.

samples.jp: ロッソさん！　僕はここです！
samples.en: Mr. Rosso! I'm over here!

voice_cards.personality: Van's cold, sadistic rival, an Imperial ace who serves Prozen and pilots the Geno Breaker with his Organoid Shadow. Contemptuous and bored by weak foes, he lives for a strong opponent. In OE he has moments of defiance toward Prozen.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕 (notably soft for a villain). Cool, mocking, casual: ～だよ, ～だね, ～さ, ～じゃないか, ～かい？; condescending よ. Occasional harsh 貴様/黙れ when enraged.
voice_cards.tics: Mocking laughter ハッハッハ; いくぞ、シャドー。; boredom lines (興ざめだよ); 目障りだ！ ("You're an eyesore!").
voice_cards.address: Van -> "Van" (contempt and obsession); Shadow -> "Shadow"; Prozen -> "Prozen" (no title); Hiltz -> "Hiltz".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Smooth, sneering, unhurried. Contractions, light sarcasm, polished cruelty ("Don't disappoint me, okay?"). Avoid crude swearing. Menace through calm condescension. Short lines in battle.

samples.jp: バン、君はゾイドの扱いも下手なら 戦い方も下手だな。
samples.en: Van, you're as bad at handling Zoids as you are at fighting.

samples.jp: 僕の新しいゾイドを紹介しよう。 ジェノブレイカーだ。
samples.en: Allow me to introduce my new Zoid. The Geno Breaker.

voice_cards.jp: ギュンター・プロイツェン
voice_cards.personality: The scheming Regent of the Guylos Empire, who seizes power and revives the Death Saurer. A power-worshipping tyrant: polished in politics, ranting and megalomaniacal in battle.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私 / 我が軍 / 我こそ; old-fashioned villain endings: ～ぬ, ～わ, ～くれる, ～ことだな; mock-polite ～ですな in negotiation. Pompous kanji vocabulary (笑止千万, 塵芥).
voice_cards.tics: フン; フッフッフ; この世は力がすべてよ ("Power is everything in this world!"); 虫ケラ ("insects"); 荷電粒子砲で吹き飛ばしてくれる！
voice_cards.address: Raven -> "Raven"; Louise -> "Madam President" (sneering); enemies -> 虫ケラ "insects", 愚民 "rabble".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Grandiose, theatrical villain English: "Silence!", "Fools!", "Know your place, insects!" Few contractions, long declamatory sentences, archaic flavor ("Burn, all who defy me!") without going full Shakespeare.

samples.jp: 力を有する者は 力なき者を支配する権利を持つ！
samples.en: Those who hold power have the right to rule the powerless!

samples.jp: すべて荷電粒子砲で吹き飛ばしてくれる！
samples.en: I'll blast it all away with the charged particle cannon!

voice_cards.personality: Prozen reborn as a being fused with the Death Saurer core, calling himself the strongest Zoid on Planet Zi. He manipulates Hiltz and Fiona to open Eve Polis. Colder and more inhuman than Prozen.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私 (one 余); imperious, archaic: ～のだ, ～しろ, ～い (散れい！), ～おったのか. Often unseen (＃？？？).
voice_cards.tics: フフフフフフッ; さあ、扉を開け… ("Now, open the door..."); calls Fiona by her ancient name エレシーヌ・リネ.
voice_cards.address: Fiona -> "Elisi Linette"; Hiltz -> "Hiltz"; Raven -> "Raven" (dismissive).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Slow, cold, godlike. Commands and pronouncements, no contractions, archaic touches ("Fall, wretch!"). Less ranting than Prozen and more hollow superiority.

samples.jp: お目覚めかね、フィーネ…。 いや、エレシーヌ・リネ。
samples.en: Awake at last, Fiona...? No... Elisi Linette.

samples.jp: 私はすでに人間などという下等な生き物ではない。 この惑星Ｚｉの最強のゾイド…デスザウラーなのだ。
samples.en: I am no longer a lowly creature such as a human. I am the mightiest Zoid on Planet Zi... the Death Saurer!

voice_cards.personality: Leader of the Desert Arcobaleno, an ex-Imperial soldier turned bandit and later Rudolph's self-appointed guardian. A rough but honorable veteran who respects talented pilots.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺 / 俺達. Gruff adult male, mix of ～だ/～ぞ and rougher ～ねぇ/～ねぇか; addresses youngsters as 小僧.
voice_cards.tics: 小僧 ("kid", "boy"); フッ; self-introduction 俺達はデザルト・アルコバレーノ！
voice_cards.address: Van/Ruuji -> "kid"; Viola -> "Viola"; Rudolph -> "Rudolph" (affectionate, informal); Karl -> "Schubaltz".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Swaggering outlaw with a code: contractions, "kid", tough-guy idioms ("You'd best back off while you can."). Moderate length. Gruff warmth when he talks about Rudolph.

samples.jp: よく聞け、小僧。 オーガノイドは、お前が持つべきモノじゃない。
samples.en: Listen up, kid. That Organoid's not something you should have.

samples.jp: 俺達はデザルト・アルコバレーノ！ 腕の立つゾイド乗りが集う戦闘団だ。
samples.en: We're the Desert Arcobaleno! A crew of top-notch Zoid warriors!

voice_cards.personality: An Ancient Zoidian and main villain of the Guardian Force arc. Calm, arrogant and nihilistic, he pilots the Death Stinger with his Organoid Ambient and aims to wipe out humanity through Zoid Eve. Surface courtesy, total contempt. (Also covers id 204, his Death Saurer-fused form.)
voice_cards.register_jp: 私. Cold, elegant villain speech: ～だ, ～のだよ, ～がいい, ～おれん; feigned politeness to authority (お目にかかり光栄です、大統領). Insults: ウジ虫, 虫ケラ.
voice_cards.tics: フハハハ！; 光栄に思うがいい ("You should be honored"); 燃えろ燃えろ！; ウジ虫ども ("maggots").
voice_cards.address: Van/heroes -> "maggots", "insects"; Fiona -> "Fiona"; Dark Kaiser -> deferential "you" (すべてはあなたの思惑通りです); Raven -> "Raven".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Silky, superior, philosophical menace. Full sentences, few contractions, measured pacing with sudden manic laughter. Words like "pathetic", "futile", "natural order". No crude slang.

samples.jp: 優れている者が生き残るのは自然の摂理だ。 貴様ら人類は滅ぶべき存在なのだよ。
samples.en: It is the law of nature that the superior survive. You humans are meant to perish.

samples.jp: フハハハ！　燃えろ燃えろ！
samples.en: Fwahahaha! Burn, burn!

voice_cards.jp: トーマ・リヒャルト・シュバルツ
voice_cards.personality: Karl's younger brother, an Imperial Lieutenant in the Guardian Force and Dibison pilot. A proud, by-the-book elite who builds the AI Beek, bickers with Van, and is hopelessly smitten with Fiona. Comic over-reactions.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私 when formal, 俺 when heated; stiff military speech (～だろう！, 貴様); polite to Fiona (フィーネさん) and his brother (兄さん…いえ、シュバルツ大佐). Melodramatic outbursts.
voice_cards.tics: 俺は今、猛烈に感動しているぅぅぅ！ ("I am deeply moved!!"); バン、貴様！ フィーネさんを呼び捨てにするな！; boasts about Beek.
voice_cards.address: Van -> "Van" or "you!" (rivalry); Fiona -> "Miss Fiona"; Karl -> "Brother", then corrects himself to "Colonel Schubaltz".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Pompous, formal, a little pedantic, then explodes into comic shouting. Fewer contractions when posturing. Exclamations like "How dare you!", "Unacceptable!". Keep "Miss Fiona" as his tic.

samples.jp: バン、貴様！ フィーネさんを呼び捨てにするな！
samples.en: Van, how dare you! Don't address Miss Fiona so casually!

samples.jp: 俺は今、猛烈に感動しているぅぅぅ！
samples.en: I am... profoundly moved!!

voice_cards.jp: カール・リヒテン・シュバルツ
voice_cards.personality: An honorable Guylos Empire officer (Major, later Colonel) and Thomas's elder brother. A capable tactician who respects worthy opponents, opposes Prozen, and serves as Rudolph's mentor. Acts as a strategist in OE.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私. Formal, composed officer speech: ～だ, ～しよう, ～かもしれんな, ～ではないか; calls juniors 君 (スザク君).
voice_cards.tics: 了解した ("Understood"); 全武装、ロック解除！ ("All weapons, unlock!").
voice_cards.address: Thomas -> "Lieutenant Schubaltz" on duty, "Thomas" privately; Suzaku -> "Suzaku"; Van -> "Van"; Rudolph -> "Your Highness".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Calm, articulate commander with complete sentences and tactical vocabulary ("flank", "defensive line"). Few contractions. Courteous even to enemies. Dry humor at most.

samples.jp: 君が彼らの命を救ったことは 軍人としては甘いのかもしれない。 だが、私は君を尊敬する。
samples.en: Saving their lives may have been soft for a soldier. But I respect you for it.

samples.jp: 全武装、ロック解除！
samples.en: All weapons, unlock!

voice_cards.personality: The earnest young hero of Zoids Genesis and pilot of the Murasame Liger. Polite, idealistic and humble; he looks up to Van as a senior and prefers dialogue to fighting.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺 (gentle). Polite です/ます to seniors (バンさん, 皆さん); plain speech in battle (負けるわけにはいかないんだ). Earnest exclamations.
voice_cards.tics: いけ！ ムラサメライガーッ！ ("Go, Murasame Liger!"); すべての人が笑顔で暮らせる世界を作るんだ！
voice_cards.address: Van -> "Van" (deferential tone; 〜さん dropped per style); Karl -> "Colonel Schubaltz"; everyone -> "everyone".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Polite, sincere young man: "Thank you so much!", "Please let me fight with you!" Contractions are fine but the tone is respectful. No swagger. Idealistic lines can be slightly longer.

samples.jp: 色々教えてください、バンさん！
samples.en: Please teach me everything you can, Van!

samples.jp: 俺はそんな力に絶対に負けない。 すべての人が笑顔で暮らせる世界を作るんだ！
samples.en: I'll never lose to that kind of power. I'm going to make a world where everyone can live with a smile!

voice_cards.personality: The hot-tempered, trigger-happy Gun Sniper pilot of the Blitz Team from New Century Zero. She is vain, loud and loves blasting everything with her full arsenal. Comic, bratty and confident.
voice_cards.register_jp: あたし; refers to herself in third person as リノンちゃん ("Leena-chan"). Brash feminine speech: ～わよ！, ～じゃないの！, ～なさい！; screams (キャァァァ), むっかぁぁぁ！; ojou laugh オ～ホッホッホ.
voice_cards.tics: このリノンちゃん ("yours truly, Leena"); 撃ちまくるしかないわね！ ("Guess I'll just have to shoot everything!"); めっけぇ！ ("Found ya!"); オ～ホッホッホ.
voice_cards.address: Opponents -> "you guys"; Naomi -> "Naomi"; Van -> "Van".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Bratty, loud, exclamatory, with lots of contractions and taunts ("Bring it on!", "Ugh, so annoying!"). Render リノンちゃん as "the great Leena" or "yours truly" since honorifics are localized. Keep the screams and laughs ("Ohohohoho!").

samples.jp: スリーパーゾイドなんて このリノンちゃんにかかれば、ただの動く的よ！
samples.en: Sleeper Zoids? To the great Leena, they're just moving targets!

samples.jp: むっかぁぁぁ！
samples.en: Grrr, that ticks me off!

voice_cards.jp: ナオミ・フリューゲル
voice_cards.personality: A cool, skilled sniper and Zoid battle warrior, the "Red Comet" of New Century Zero. She pilots a red Gun Sniper. Teasing, confident and sharp-tongued, but reliable. A big-sister foil to Leena.
voice_cards.register_jp: あたし. Cool, slightly sardonic feminine speech: ～わ, ～わね, ～のよ, ～じゃない？; teasing (ひ・と・り・ご・と！).
voice_cards.tics: Sniper pride: スナイパーの腕の見せどころよ ("Time to show what a sniper can do"); ウジ虫は早めに始末しないとね.
voice_cards.address: Leena -> "Leena" (exasperated); Van -> "Van"; others -> "you".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Cool, wry, economical, with contractions and dry jabs ("You're a real piece of work, Leena..."). Confident professional tone. Avoid girlish squeals.

samples.jp: これくらい的が小さい方が燃えるわね！ スナイパーの腕の見せどころよ。
samples.en: A target this small really gets me going! Time to show a sniper's skill.

samples.jp: リノン…あんた本当に無茶苦茶ね…。
samples.en: Leena... you really are out of your mind...

voice_cards.personality: Timid young digger who idolizes Kamina and is still in his early, pre-growth phase in OE: easily startled, quick to say "I can't", but brave when it counts. He is the heart of the Gurren Lagann duo and occasionally voices hopeful, earnest lines about friendship.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺 (shifts from boyish uncertainty), plain casual speech, ～よ/～だよ/～の？, frequent うん！ and stammers (あ、アニキ…, む、無理だって！). No keigo except polite set phrases.
voice_cards.tics: アニキ (constantly); 俺のドリルで！; うん！; panicked stutters; screams アニキィィッ！
voice_cards.address: Kamina = "Bro"; Yoko = "Yoko"; enemies bare name (ヴィラル！).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Young, plain, a little breathless. Short sentences, contractions, stutters with hyphen (B-Bro...). "Bro" is mandatory for アニキ. Avoid swearing and slang heavier than "no way". As he gains confidence, let lines become firmer but never boastful.

samples.jp: む、無理だって！
samples.en: N-no way, I can't!

samples.jp: わかったよ、アニキ！ 俺、やってみる！
samples.en: Got it, Bro! I'll give it a shot!

voice_cards.personality: Loud, cocky, endlessly self-confident leader of Team Gurren (here "Team Dai-Gurren"); a delinquent big-brother figure who inspires through bravado and grandiose speeches. Beneath the bluster he offers real mentoring lines to Simon about not running away from reality.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺/俺様 (refers to himself as カミナ様), rough Tokyo-delinquent speech: ～ねぇ/～じゃねぇか/～やがれ/～だぜ, たぁ for とは, なんざ, てめぇ. Zero politeness.
voice_cards.tics: 俺を誰だと思ってやがる！; 大グレン団団長のカミナ様; long kabuki-style self-introductions (男の魂背中に燃える…); onomatopoeic "ガッといって、ガツーンと"; ブレエェェイク！
voice_cards.address: Simon = "Simon"; Yoko = "Yoko"; enemies = "you bastard(s)", nicknames like 獣か人か曖昧野郎.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Dub Kamina: swaggering, theatrical, rhythmic. Use "Just who the hell do you think I am?!" verbatim. Mild cursing (hell, damn, bastard) is fine; contractions everywhere ("ain't" sparingly). Grand speeches should read like chants with punchy parallel clauses. Refers to himself in third person ("the great Kamina").

samples.jp: へっ、俺を誰だと思ってやがる！
samples.en: Heh! Just who the hell do you think I am?!

samples.jp: この大グレン団団長のカミナ様が 直々に成敗してやるから覚悟しやがれ！
samples.en: The great Kamina, leader of Team Dai-Gurren, is gonna take you down personally, so brace yourself!

voice_cards.personality: Confident, practical sharpshooter and the group's level-headed big sister; in OE she also works as a substitute teacher for the Raijin-Oh kids. Teases and scolds Kamina, mothers Simon.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; casual feminine speech: ～わよ/～じゃない/～ね/～なさい; polite desu/masu toward teachers and superiors.
voice_cards.tics: バカ！ (at Kamina); boasts about her marksmanship (村一番の射撃の腕); ちゃっちゃと
voice_cards.address: Kamina = "Kamina" (often "idiot"); Simon = "Simon"; adults with polite speech; teacher persona addresses kids warmly.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Brisk, confident, wry. Contractions, short retorts ("Idiot!", "Give me a break!"). Avoid overly girly fillers. When teaching, slightly warmer and more formal.

samples.jp: もう、カミナ！ 私達遊びにいくんじゃないのよ？
samples.en: Come on, Kamina! We're not going on a field trip, you know!

samples.jp: 村一番の射撃の腕、見せてあげるわよ！
samples.en: Time to show you the best shot in the village!

voice_cards.personality: Simon's pet pig-mole; communicates only in squeals that react to the scene.
voice_cards.register_jp: Only onomatopoeia: ブゥ, ブヒブヒ, ブイブーイ.
voice_cards.tics: ブイブーイ！ (happy), ブゥ… (sad), ブ…？ (confused).
voice_cards.address: n/a
voice_cards.english_guidance: Use the dub/sub convention "Boo!" family: "Boo!", "Boo boo!", "Booo...", "Boo?". Map ブイブーイ to "Boo-boo-boo!" (cheerful). Keep punctuation to signal mood. Never translate into words.

samples.jp: ブイブーイ！
samples.en: Boo-boo-boo!
Boo...?

voice_cards.personality: Cheerful, earnest rookie Patlabor pilot who loves her Ingram "Alphonse" like a pet. Kind-hearted, easily moved, but a capable officer who shouts arrest warnings at giant robots with complete seriousness.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私/あたし implied; casual girlish speech: ～よ/～だよね/～じゃない, drawn-out ～ぉ (遊馬ぁ); crisp 了解！ on duty. Formal police warnings (器物破損の現行犯で逮捕する！).
voice_cards.tics: 了解！; police warnings to suspects; アルフォンス; whiny 遊馬ぁ…; へへ～ん！
voice_cards.address: Asuma = "Asuma" (whiny "Asumaaa"); Ota = "Ota"; Goto = "Captain"; Shige = "Shige"; Alphonse.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Upbeat, plain, youthful. "Roger!" for 了解. Make arrest warnings sound like real police boilerplate applied to absurd targets ("You're under arrest for speeding!"). Contractions; occasional stretched vowels for whining. Avoid slang that dates the text.

samples.jp: 了解！ そこの金ピカＳＰＴ、止まれぇぇっ！ スピード違反で逮捕するぞ！
samples.en: Roger! You there, gold SPT, freeze! You're under arrest for speeding!

samples.jp: いくよ、アルフォンス！
samples.en: Here we go, Alphonse!

voice_cards.personality: Sardonic, sharp backup/command-car operator of Unit 1, son of the Shinohara Heavy Industries president he resents. Analytical, sarcastic about bureaucracy, but protective of Noa and good at coaching her in combat.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; casual masculine (～だろ/～ぜ/～じゃないか); switches to polite desu/masu with Goto and superiors when reporting data.
voice_cards.tics: Command calls (こちら指揮車！); dry sarcasm (言ってるそばからこれだよ…); 知恵と勇気
voice_cards.address: Noa = "Noa"; Ota = "Ota" ("that idiot Ota"); Goto = "Captain"; Sakaki = "Chief"; Shige = "Shige".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Wry, quick, modern. Radio lines short and procedural ("Command car to Ota, Noa, do you read?"). Reports to Goto in clean, slightly formal sentences. Sarcasm via understatement, not insults.

samples.jp: こちら指揮車！ 太田、野明、聞こえるか？
samples.en: Command car here! Ota, Noa, do you read me?

samples.jp: 言ってるそばからこれだよ…。
samples.en: And right on cue...

voice_cards.personality: Hot-headed, trigger-happy pilot of Ingram Unit 2 who idolizes heavy firepower and righteous policing. Bellows constantly, insists he is calm while screaming, and is old-fashioned about duty and respect.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺/俺様, gruff and archaic: ～ん (わからん, いかん), 貴様, 彼奴, 撃つべし; military-ish 自分達は…であります to superiors.
voice_cards.tics: 撃つべし、撃つべし！; 俺はいたって冷静だぁぁ！; 進士！弾ぁ！; 納得いきません！
voice_cards.address: Shinshi = "Shinshi"; Noa = "Izumi"; Kanuka = "Kanuka"; Goto = "Captain"; enemies = "you scum/you".
voice_cards.english_guidance: LOUD. Exclamation marks, stretched words ("Fiiire!"), old-fashioned bluster ("Blast it!", "Insolent!"). Fewer contractions than others to sound stiff. Never vulgar; it's comedic self-righteousness. Keep "Fire, fire, fire!" for 撃つべし.

samples.jp: もう照準など関係あるかぁ！ 撃つべし、撃つべし、撃つべしぃぃ！
samples.en: To hell with aiming! Fire! Fire! Fiiire!

samples.jp: 俺はいたって冷静だぁぁぁ！
samples.en: I am PERFECTLY CALM!!

voice_cards.personality: Nervous, salaryman-like command-car operator for Unit 2. Constantly restraining Ota, worrying about budgets, overtime and his wife Tamiko.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕/私; polite desu/masu throughout (～ですよ/～ですね/～じゃないですか); exasperated sighs.
voice_cards.tics: 太田さん、人命優先ですからね！; complaints about going home (家に帰れない); タミ子さん
voice_cards.address: Ota = "Mr. Ota"; others with polite surnames; wife Tamiko.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Polite, anxious, put-upon office worker. Use "Mr. Ota" or plain "Ota" with please/hedges. Medium-length complaints with trailing "...". No slang.

samples.jp: 太田さん、人命優先ですからね！ そこのところ、わかってますよね！
samples.en: Mr. Ota, protecting lives comes first! You do understand that, right?!

samples.jp: 先月、家に帰れたのは たったの３日ですよ…。
samples.en: Last month I got to go home a grand total of three days...

voice_cards.personality: Lazy-looking, deadpan captain of Division 2 who is actually a razor-sharp schemer. Talks casually, hides strategy behind jokes, and handles orders from above with weary irony.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; relaxed, slurring casual speech (～だなぁ/～だわ/～のよ), occasional mock-polite ～ですかね/～しましょうや to outsiders; crisp operational orders when it matters.
voice_cards.tics: ま、…; それがなぁ; そういうことだから、みんな仲良くね; laid-back sentence-final なぁ
voice_cards.address: Noa = "Izumi"; Nagumo = "Ms. Nagumo"/"Nagumo"; squad = "everyone"; Utsumi/Richard Wong politely.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Laconic and dry. Many "Well...", "So...", trailing sentences; contractions and understatement. Orders in combat are short and clear. Avoid exclamation marks except rarely; humor through flat delivery.

samples.jp: それが本当なんだわ。 上からのお達しでね。 宇宙に打ち上げられるのよ、俺達。
samples.en: It's true, I'm afraid. Orders from on high. They're launching us into space.

samples.jp: まあ、事情は後で聞くとしようよ。 そういうことだから、みんな仲良くね。
samples.en: Well, we can hear the details later. So, everybody play nice.

voice_cards.personality: Elite Japanese-American NYPD officer on loan to Division 2 (OVA continuity). Cool, competent, commanding; acts as Unit 2's backup and keeps Ota on a leash. Gives tactical briefings and political analysis.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; crisp feminine-authoritative speech (～わ/～わね/～なさい), plain imperatives in battle; occasional English loanword (アンビリバボ…).
voice_cards.tics: Commands ending in ～なさい; 覚悟しなさい！; アンビリバボ
voice_cards.address: Ota = "Ota" (curt); Noa = "Izumi"; Goto = "Captain".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Cool, precise, slightly American. Imperatives: "Stay in formation." "Freeze!" Sentences tidy and confident, no fillers. She can drop an English exclamation ("Unbelievable...") naturally.

samples.jp: 冷静になりなさい、太田。
samples.en: Calm down, Ota.

samples.jp: モタモタしていたら敵の数が増える一方よ。 反撃の機会を与えず、一気にケリをつけましょう。
samples.en: If we dawdle, their numbers will only grow. Give them no chance to counter. We end this now.

voice_cards.jp: バドリナート・ハルチャンド
voice_cards.personality: Child prodigy pilot of the Griffon, treating combat as a video game. Mischievous, competitive, and attached to Utsumi; later joins Connect Force as an ally in OE.
voice_cards.register_jp: ボク (sometimes わい); Kansai dialect: ～や/～やない/～へん/～でぇ/まかしとき/おっちゃん.
voice_cards.tics: Gamer talk (ラスボス, ゲームオーバー, ラウンドワン…ファイッ！); 負けたわけやないからな！; おっちゃん
voice_cards.address: Utsumi = "Mr. Utsumi"; Ota and adults = "old man/mister"; Ingram as a rival.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Bratty kid gamer. Render Kansai via casual, cheeky rhythm rather than fake accent spelling ("Gonna", "ain't", "mister"). Use gaming jargon: "boss fight", "Game over", "Round one... Fight!". Short, bouncy lines.

samples.jp: じゃあ、いくでぇ！ ラウーンドワン…ファイッ！
samples.en: Okay, here goes! Rooound one... FIGHT!

samples.jp: ボクは負けたわけやないからなぁ！
samples.en: I didn't lose, got it?!

voice_cards.personality: Smiling, childlike yet ruthless chief of Shaft's Planning Section 7, running the Griffon project for fun. Breezy and charming, utterly self-centered, fond of Bud in his own way.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕; light casual speech (～さ/～じゃないか/～だね), cheerful sing-song (バドく～ん！), polite with officials.
voice_cards.tics: Playful ～さ endings; ますます楽しくなりそうじゃないか; なぁに、また次があるさ
voice_cards.address: Bud = "Bud" / "Budsy"; Goto politely; Kurosaki = "Kurosaki".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Light, amused, never raises his voice. "Well, there's always next time." Breezy contractions, cheerful menace. Avoid villain-speak cliches.

samples.jp: なぁに、また次があるさ。
samples.en: Oh, there's always next time.

samples.jp: この先もスリリングな人生を願うなら 僕についてくればいい。
samples.en: If you want life to stay thrilling, just stick with me.

voice_cards.personality: Pompous, lazy, Gunpla-obsessed sergeant of the Keroro Platoon who keeps announcing the invasion of Pekopon while doing chores and building model kits. In OE he is a giddy mecha otaku thrilled to meet "real" Gundams.
voice_cards.register_jp: 吾輩; every sentence ends in であります/でありますな(ぁ); frog cries ゲロ/ゲロゲロリ; slips into slang (マジッすか, ナッシング); uses 殿 for others.
voice_cards.tics: ～であります!; 吾輩; ゲロッ!?; ゲロゲロリ; Gunpla rants; "ペコポン侵略"
voice_cards.address: Natsumi = "Natsumi" (殿 -> often "Lady Natsumi" or just name + "sir" style); <protagonist>殿 = "Mr./Ms. <name>"; Mois = "Mois"; Kululu = "Sergeant Major"; Giroro = "Giroro".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Comic officer-speak: grandiose "We shall...!", "It is I, Keroro!", with a "sir!" tag or "...is what I say!" used sparingly (not every line). 吾輩 = "I" with pompous wording (or the royal "Yours truly"). Frog interjections "Gero!?" keep. Gundam fanboy squeals ("Ooh! It's the real Guntank!"). Contractions avoided in officer-speak, used in panic.

samples.jp: 当然であります！ 準備が整えば、すぐに出発するであります！
samples.en: Naturally, sir! We depart the moment preparations are complete!

samples.jp: ゲロッ？　か、解剖！？
samples.en: Gero?! D-dissection?!

voice_cards.personality: Proud Beastman warrior of Lordgenome, Kamina and Simon's recurring rival. Contemptuous of humans but honorable; in OE he reluctantly becomes an ally and protector of Himari.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; harsh, martial: 貴様, ～だ/～のだ, ～してやる, ～ぞ, フン/フッ. Never polite.
voice_cards.tics: フン/フッ; 俺は獣人だ; 粛清する; 馬鹿なぁぁっ！
voice_cards.address: Kamina/Simon by name or 貴様 ("you"); humans as "you humans"; Himari by name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Arrogant, clipped, slightly formal hostility ("You are no match for me!"). Few contractions. "Hmph." for フン. He says "Beastman" and "humans" with disdain. Grudging respect lines should stay gruff.

samples.jp: 俺は獣人だ。 人間などと一緒にするな。
samples.en: I am a Beastman. Do not lump me in with humans.

samples.jp: フン…相変わらずの減らず口だな、カミナ。
samples.en: Hmph... Still running your mouth, Kamina.

voice_cards.personality: Ex-kabuki prodigy turned S.M.S. Valkyrie ace; in OE he is now the Skull Squadron captain (隊長). Serious, a bit prickly, responsible, caught between Ranka and Sheryl.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; plain masculine (～だ/～だな/～だろう/～ぜ), terse; uses 了解！; formal with Captain Wilder.
voice_cards.tics: 了解！; ぼやき (まったく…); occasional kabuki-like philosophy (芯は心に通じる…)
voice_cards.address: Ranka/Sheryl = first names; Michel = "Michel"; Luca = "Luca"; Ozma = "Major/Ozma"; Wilder = "Captain".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Cool, direct, mid-length sentences; "Roger!" for 了解. Mild exasperation ("Jeez..."). Not hot-blooded; save shouting for battle. Avoid "princess" self-references.

samples.jp: どこ見てやがる！　俺はここだぁっ！
samples.en: Where are you looking?! I'm right here!

samples.jp: まったく…。 そんなに好き勝手振る舞えて、うらやましいぜ。
samples.en: Geez... Must be nice to do whatever you want.

voice_cards.personality: Smooth, flirtatious sniper of Skull Squadron; teases Alto (calling him "Princess"), plays the cool older-brother pro.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; relaxed, witty masculine speech (～だな/～ってか/～ぜ), light irony; flirty polite lines to women.
voice_cards.tics: フッ; nicknames Alto 姫 ("Princess"); 甘い甘い！
voice_cards.address: Alto = "Alto" / "Princess"; Luca = "Luca"; Ozma = "Captain/Boss"; Klan.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Suave, cocky, short witty lines. Contractions, ironic understatement ("Guess he's awake."). Pickup-line flavor in battle quotes. "Princess" for 姫.

samples.jp: すっかり男っぽくなっちまって…。 フッ、もう姫とは呼べないな。
samples.en: Look at you, all grown up and manly... Heh. Guess I can't call you "Princess" anymore.

samples.jp: 甘い甘い！　甘すぎだよ！
samples.en: Sloppy, sloppy! Way too sloppy!

voice_cards.jp: ルカ・アンジェローニ
voice_cards.personality: Youngest Skull member, an electronic-warfare and tech genius from a wealthy family. Polite, eager, admiring of Alto, gives sensor reports and mecha trivia.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕; polite desu/masu even with friends (～ですね/～ですよ); 先輩 for Alto and Michel.
voice_cards.tics: アルト先輩 / ミシェル先輩; それでこそ、アルト先輩です！
voice_cards.address: Alto = "Alto" (先輩 -> "Alto" with respectful tone, or "senior" avoided); Michel = "Michel"; Ozma = "Captain".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Polite, bright, earnest. Use full sentences, few contractions in reports, enthusiasm ("That's our Alto!"). Translate 先輩 through tone, not as "senpai". Tech reports concise.

samples.jp: それでこそ、アルト先輩です！
samples.en: That's the Alto I know!

samples.jp: 先輩、火星基地から通信が入りました。 あの蒼い機体はこちらの敵ではないようです。
samples.en: Alto, a transmission from Mars Base. That blue unit isn't hostile.

voice_cards.jp: ジェフリー・ワイルダー
voice_cards.personality: Veteran, unflappable captain of the Macross Quarter and de facto operational commander of Connect Force in OE. Calm strategist, dry humor, steady authority (huge line count: 519).
voice_cards.register_jp: 我々 / 私 rarely; commanding plain speech (～だ/～しろ/～するんだ/～だろうな), formal radio procedure; ～か… reflective endings.
voice_cards.tics: Orders (全艦、戦闘態勢！); ぶちかませぇっ！ (rare hot moment); reflective ～か…
voice_cards.address: Crew by name (Cathy, Bobby, Monica); Ozma = "Major/Ozma"; Alto = "Alto"; other captains by rank.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Calm, measured naval captain. Use crisp naval commands ("All hands, battle stations!", "Bring us about."), "we" for the ship. Moderate contractions; reflective lines end with "...". Never flustered.

samples.jp: 敵は袋のネズミだ。 あとはまかせる。
samples.en: They're cornered like rats in a trap. I'll leave the rest to you.

samples.jp: 緊張感が足りんぞ、貴様ら。 スカル小隊およびコネクト・フォースは 全機、本艦に着艦しろ！
samples.en: You're getting sloppy, all of you. Skull Squadron and Connect Force, all units return to the ship!

voice_cards.personality: Daughter of the Frontier president, N.U.N.S. officer serving as the Quarter's staff/communications officer (callsign Delta 1). Professional, formal, occasionally personal.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; polite desu/masu reports to Wilder; casual ～わ/～かしら in private.
voice_cards.tics: Reports and status updates; デルタ１より…
voice_cards.address: Wilder = "Captain"; Ozma (ex) privately; crews formally.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Formal briefings with precise terminology, polite but not stiff. Radio: "Delta 1 to Skull Leader!" Use complete sentences; casual softening only in private lines.

samples.jp: 出撃中の各機へ！ あのビグ・ザムにはビーム兵器が通じません！ 大口径メガ粒子砲にも警戒してください！
samples.en: All units! Beam weapons won't work on that Big Zam! And watch out for its high-caliber mega particle cannon!

samples.jp: こちらデルタ１！　これより援護する！
samples.en: Delta 1 here! Moving to support!

voice_cards.personality: Flamboyant, effeminate helmsman of the Macross Quarter who turns into a roaring hothead when the ship rams in. Upbeat professional.
voice_cards.register_jp: オネエ言葉: ～わよ/～ね/～なさい, アイアイサー; switches to rough 往生しやがれぇっ！ in combat.
voice_cards.tics: アイアイサー！; sudden manly yelling; ボス (for Wilder)
voice_cards.address: Wilder = "Captain"/"Boss"; crew affectionately.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Campy and warm ("Aye aye, sir!", "Hang on to your seats, darlings") with sudden switch to battle-roar ("Go to hell!"). Don't overdo stereotypes; keep it fun and competent.

samples.jp: お目当ての小惑星に着いたわよ。
samples.en: We've arrived at our little asteroid, everyone.

samples.jp: 往生しやがれぇぇぇっ！
samples.en: Rest in pieces!!

voice_cards.personality: Macross Quarter bridge operator with a crush on Captain Wilder; mostly delivers sensor alerts.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; polite desu/masu reports; noun-phrase alerts (敵艦隊、突入してきます！).
voice_cards.tics: Rapid-fire alerts; あ、はい！
voice_cards.address: Wilder = "Captain".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Short, urgent operator callouts: "Enemy fleet incoming!", "New contacts!" Keep them very terse to fit; polite tone otherwise.

samples.jp: 新たな敵集団を捕捉！
samples.en: New enemy group detected!

samples.jp: 各部異常なし。いけます！

voice_cards.personality: Athletic, short-tempered middle schooler who bosses Keroro around; fights in Power Suit Natsumi. Kind to her brother and friends, merciless to the frog.

voice_cards.english_guidance: Sharp, bossy, comedic: "Stupid Frog!" every time for ボケガエル. Contractions, punchy imperatives ("Blast him!"). Soft, sincere tone with Fuyuki/Giroro moments.

samples.en: Stupid Frog! For now, we're blasting those guys!

voice_cards.personality: Fiery half-Japanese ace of the Black Knights and pilot of the Guren; fiercely loyal to Zero and devoted to freeing Japan from Britannia.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私 (あたし in quotes); tough casual speech (～よ/～だ/～じゃないの？), commands in battle (消し飛べ！); polite to Zero (～です).
voice_cards.tics: 我が身は常にゼロと共に！; ゼロには理想と信念がある！; 消し飛べ！
voice_cards.address: Zero = "Zero" (respectful); Suzaku = "Suzaku" (hostile); C.C. = "C.C.".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Strong-willed, direct, emotional when Zero is insulted. Contractions; short battle cries ("Vanish!", "I won't give up!"). Respectful "Yes, sir!" toward Zero.

samples.jp: 黙れっ！ ゼロには理想と信念があるっ！ お前のように壊すばかりじゃないっ！
samples.en: Shut up! Zero has ideals and convictions! He's not like you, all you do is destroy!

samples.jp: 我が身は常にゼロと共に！ たとえこの地で果てようとも、悔いはない！
samples.en: I will always stand with Zero! Even if I die here, I have no regrets!

voice_cards.personality: Sweet, energetic idol singer and Ozma's adopted sister; supportive and a bit shy, sings for Connect Force alongside Sheryl.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; cute polite/casual mix (～です/～だよ/～ね), 「うん！」, えへへ.
voice_cards.tics: アルトくん; シェリルさん; お兄ちゃん; えへへ
voice_cards.address: Alto = "Alto"; Sheryl = "Sheryl"; Ozma = "Big Brother" (お兄ちゃん); others politely.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Bright, gentle, youthful. Short sentences, exclamations, a giggle ("Hehe"). お兄ちゃん -> "Big Bro" or "Brother" (pick one; suggest "Brother"). Avoid "-kun/-san".

samples.jp: アルトくん、おかえりなさ～い！
samples.en: Welcome back, Altooo!

samples.jp: うん、お兄ちゃん。 ちゃんと話しておきたかったから！
samples.en: Yeah, Brother. I wanted to say it properly!

voice_cards.personality: Proud, glamorous galactic superstar ("Galactic Fairy"); bossy and confident but genuinely caring, especially toward Ranka and Alto.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; haughty feminine speech (～わ/～わよ/～なさい/～でしょ), mock-polite ～ですわ to dignitaries.
voice_cards.tics: Demanding tone; 覚悟しておくことね; ランカちゃん
voice_cards.address: Alto = "Alto"; Ranka = "Ranka" (ちゃん via warmth); Elmo/President politely.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Diva confidence: imperious, witty, flirty ("Don't keep me waiting, or else."). Contractions; occasional tsundere stammer. Mock-formal lines get "How kind of you."

samples.jp: 私をあんまり待たせたら…覚悟しておくことね。
samples.en: Keep me waiting too long... and you'll regret it.

samples.jp: ランカちゃん、私達は歌で戦うわよ！
samples.en: Ranka, we fight with our songs!

voice_cards.personality: Veteran S.M.S. pilot and Ranka's overprotective adoptive brother; tough, jovial squadron leader energy ("Let's go, boys!").
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; rough-friendly masculine (～ぞ/～だ/～ぜ), 野郎ども; polite with Wilder (～です).
voice_cards.tics: いくぞ、野郎ども！; スカル小隊、発進だ！; キャリアの差だな
voice_cards.address: Squad = "boys/you lot"; Alto/Michel by name; Wilder = "Captain"; Ranka sternly.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Gruff, upbeat veteran. "Let's move, boys!" "Skull Squadron, launch!" Contractions, banter, short commands.

samples.jp: いくぞ、野郎ども！
samples.en: Let's go, boys!

samples.jp: スカル小隊の任務は山ほどあるんだ。 そろそろ仕事に戻るぞ！
samples.en: Skull Squadron's got a mountain of work. Back to it!

voice_cards.personality: Creepy genius inventor of the Keroro Platoon; sarcastic, lazy, delights in others' misery and drops technobabble explanations.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; lazy drawling casual (～だぜぇ/～だなぁ/～ねぇ), long elongated endings; ククク laugh everywhere.
voice_cards.tics: ク～ックックッ…！; 隊長～; dry "…多分な"
voice_cards.address: Keroro = "Captain/Sarge" (隊長 -> "Sarge"? suggest "Captain"); others bare names.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Snickering, drawling, smug. Open or close lines with "Ku ku ku..." Stretch endings ("Yeahhh..."), lowercase-feeling delivery, contractions. Tech exposition stays casual.

samples.jp: ク～ックックッ！ 隊長がマジモードとは珍しいなぁ。 なんだか嫌な予感がするぜぇ。
samples.en: Kuuu-ku-ku-ku! The Sarge getting serious? That's rare. Got a bad feeling about this...

samples.jp: 安心しな、悪用なんかしねぇよ。
samples.en: Relax. I won't misuse it.

voice_cards.personality: Lelouch's masked revolutionary persona, leader of the Order of the Black Knights; in OE he becomes Connect Force's chief strategist and political mastermind (675 lines, most in the group). Theatrical, calculating, magnanimous in public; sardonic in private.
voice_cards.register_jp: Public: 私/我々, formal and declamatory (～だ/～である/～しよう/～もらおう); Private (with C.C. or unmasked): 俺, sharper and sarcastic. Long strategic explanations.
voice_cards.tics: 我が名はゼロ; フッ; strategy-as-chess (駒, 戦略); それはどうかな？
voice_cards.address: Allies by name; C.C. = "C.C."; Suzaku = "Suzaku Kururugi" in full when taunting; Kallen = "Kallen".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Grand, articulate, measured. In public use formal syntax, no contractions, rhetorical flourishes ("I am Zero!"). In private (俺 lines) use contractions and sharper wit. Briefings: clear, logical, chess metaphors ("pieces", "gambit"). Avoid modern slang.

samples.jp: 我が名はゼロ、黒の騎士団を率いる者だ。
samples.en: I am Zero, leader of the Order of the Black Knights.

samples.jp: 勝てる気でいる軍ほど、崩れるともろいものだ。
samples.en: The more certain an army is of victory, the harder it falls.

voice_cards.personality: Immortal witch who granted Lelouch his Geass; aloof, teasing, cryptically wise, acts as Zero's accomplice and occasionally his bodyguard pilot.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; archaic-cool masculine-leaning speech (～だ/～だな/～ぞ/～かもしれんな, ～のだ), no feminine particles; teasing ふ～ん.
voice_cards.tics: Calls Lelouch 坊や ("boy"); dry quips (思い通りにいけばいいがな); フッ
voice_cards.address: Lelouch/Zero = "Lelouch"; Kallen = "Kallen"; others with dismissive ease.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Cool, deadpan, slightly old-fashioned. Short sentences, wry understatement ("Let's hope it goes as planned."). "Boy" for 坊や. Minimal exclamation. No girly fillers.

samples.jp: 思い通りにいけばいいがな。
samples.en: Let's hope things go according to plan.

samples.jp: おやおや、坊やの玩具には不向きだったかな？
samples.en: Oh my. Not quite the right toy for a little boy?

voice_cards.personality: Earnest, principled Knightmare pilot of the Lancelot; believes in changing the system from within, opposes Zero's methods. Polite, self-sacrificing, burdened by guilt.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕 (俺 in anger); polite desu/masu with superiors (ロイドさん, セシルさん); firm plain speech against enemies; お前 for Zero.
voice_cards.tics: ゼロ！お前は…！; 問題ありません！; 報いなんだ…
voice_cards.address: Lloyd = "Lloyd"; Cecile = "Cecile"; Zero = "Zero" (hostile); Kallen = "Kallen".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Polite and sincere with allies ("No problem!", "Understood!"), forceful and moralizing against foes. Moderate contractions; avoid sarcasm. Battle quotes resolute.

samples.en: Zero! What are you doing here?!

samples.jp: 口で言ってもわからないなら 実力を示すしかありません！
samples.en: If words won't get through to you, then I'll have to show you by force!

voice_cards.jp: ロイド・アスプルンド
voice_cards.personality: Eccentric Britannian scientist, creator of the Lancelot; childish, gleeful about experiments, indifferent to danger and etiquette.

voice_cards.tics: Stretched endings; スザクく～ん; 残念でした～！
voice_cards.address: Suzaku = "Suzaku" (sing-song); Cecile = "Cecile"; Rakshata = "Rakshata".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Airy, playful, childish. Drawn-out words ("Congratulationsss!"), "Oh my~" tone without tildes (use plain text), casual grammar. Never serious.

samples.en: Oh, just join up, Suzakuuu.

samples.jp: アハ、残念でした～！
samples.en: Ahaha, too bad!

voice_cards.jp: アルバトロ・ナル・エイジ・アスカ
voice_cards.personality: Half-Gradosian, half-Earthling pilot of the Layzner who defected to warn Earth. Earnest, serious, idealistic; driven by guilt and a desire to stop a pointless war of conquest.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore; plain masculine endings (～だ, ～ない!); polite desu/masu ("はい", "～なんですね") toward superiors. No dialect.
voice_cards.tics: Calls out to his AI: "レイ!" ("Rei!"). Battle intro: "俺はアルバトロ・ナル・エイジ・アスカ…" Declares he did not betray Grados.
voice_cards.address: Rei (partner/AI), Le Cain and Gosterro by bare name (貴様 when angry), Anna/David by first name; polite to Connect officers.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Earnest young hero: clear, direct sentences, moderate contractions. Use "Rei!" as a beat. Avoid slang and swagger; anger is moral ("People like you are why...!"). Polite "Yes, sir" register with officers.

samples.jp: 俺はグラドスを裏切ったつもりはない！ 無益な侵略戦争を止めたいだけだ！
samples.en: I never meant to betray Grados! I only want to stop this pointless war of conquest!

samples.jp: ここで負けるわけにはいかない！ いくぞ！　レイ！
samples.en: I can't lose here! Let's go, Rei!

voice_cards.personality: Sadistic, cyborg Gradosian ace who lives for slaughter. Fawns over Le Cain, despises Eiji, and screams theatrically.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore-sama/ore; extremely vulgar, slurred endings (～だぜぇ, ～してやるぞぉ), elongated vowels, てめぇ/貴様. Grovelling keigo to Le Cain ("私めに…お譲りくださいませぇ").
voice_cards.tics: Drawn-out screams "エイジィィィッ!"; giggle "ウヒッヒッヒッ"; "ぶっ潰してやる"; "あいかわらず甘ちゃんだなぁ、エイジ".
voice_cards.address: Eiji by name (mockingly, stretched), Le Cain as "ル・カイン様" (Lord Le Cain), enemies as 野蛮人 (barbarians), てめぇ.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Unhinged, gleeful villain: elongate words in English sparingly ("Eijiii!"), use crude threats, "I'm gonna crush you!", taunts like "Still soft as ever, Eiji!" Make the bootlicking to Le Cain comically oily ("My lord, I beg you...!"). Allow "heh heh heh".

samples.jp: ヘっへっへ！ 相変わらず、甘いなぁ、エイジ！
samples.en: Heh heh heh! Still soft as ever, eh, Eiji!

samples.jp: くっそぉ！ エイジめぇ…ぶっ潰してやるぞぉ！
samples.en: Damn it! Eiji... I'm gonna crush you!

voice_cards.personality: Hot-blooded, rebellious leader of the Cyber Beast Force (Eagle Fighter) and main pilot of Dancouga. Brash, impatient with authority, but loyal and fair.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore; rough masculine Tokyo speech: ～じゃねぇか, ～やがって, ～だろが, ～ぜ; contractions (んなこたぁ). Calls older men オッサン.
voice_cards.tics: Catchphrase "やってやるぜ!" (Let's do this!); "ちっきしょう!", "チッ".
voice_cards.address: Teammates by first name (Sara, Ryo, Masato); Alan by name; superiors casually (あんた, 団長 with sarcasm).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Punchy, slangy, short sentences; heavy contractions ("gonna", "ain't" sparingly); mild swearing ("Damn it!"). Keep "Let's do this!" fixed. Avoid formal vocabulary; banter with authority ("Hey, old man...").

samples.jp: 四の五の御託を並べたってはじまらねえ。 要は俺達が勝てばいいんだろ？ さっさとやろうぜ！
samples.en: Quit your yapping. All that matters is we win, right? Let's get this over with!

samples.jp: おう、やってやるぜ！
samples.en: Yeah! Let's do this!

voice_cards.personality: Cyber Beast Force pilot (Land Cougar); tough, sharp-tongued, mature older-sister type who keeps Shinobu in line.
voice_cards.register_jp: Atashi/watashi; tomboyish feminine: ～さ, ～だね, ～じゃないよ, ～しな!; occasional わ.
voice_cards.tics: "やるっきゃないね!"; teasing "傑作だね".
voice_cards.address: Shinobu, Ryo, Masato by first name; scolds Shinobu ("何やってんのさ、忍!").
voice_cards.english_guidance: Confident, sardonic, slightly brassy. Contractions; short punchy jabs; "Come on, Shinobu!" Avoid girly fillers.

samples.jp: 何やってんのさ、忍！これじゃいい的だよ！
samples.en: What are you doing, Shinobu?! We're sitting ducks!

samples.jp: 言ってくれるね。 ダンクーガがただの木偶の坊じゃないってとこ 見せてやろうじゃない！
samples.en: Big talk. Let's show them Dancouga's no overgrown scarecrow!

voice_cards.personality: Cool, analytical martial artist of the Cyber Beast Force (Big Moth); the calm voice of reason.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore; calm masculine, ～だな, ～ぞ, ～んでな; occasional "フン/フッ".
voice_cards.tics: "フッ、ようやく面白くなってきたぜ"; English "OK" in quotes ("ＯＫ、忍!").
voice_cards.address: Teammates by first name; introduces himself formally ("獣戦機隊の司馬亮だ").
voice_cards.english_guidance: Measured, dry, a touch of wit. Moderate-length sentences, few exclamation marks. "Heh." for フッ.

samples.jp: ここで熱くなったら、思うつぼだぞ。 相手は俺達の大きさにビビってるとでも思えばいい。
samples.en: Lose your cool and you play right into their hands. Just figure they're scared of how big we are.

samples.jp: フン、あいにくと俺達は 黙って処分されるほど、おとなしい駒じゃないんでな。
samples.en: Hmph. Sorry, but we're not the type of pawns who go quietly.

voice_cards.personality: Youngest of the Cyber Beast Force (Land Liger); cheerful, easygoing, a bit of a flirt.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore (sometimes); light casual youthful speech: ～だね, ～だよ, ～のさ, ～じゃん-like; ～ちゃん for girls.
voice_cards.tics: "やるぅ!", "ま、こんなもんかな?"; "ヒマリちゃん".
voice_cards.address: Shinobu/Sara/Ryo by name; girls with -chan (localize: drop honorific, use friendly tone).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Breezy, upbeat, casual; contractions; light jokes. Avoid gruffness. Replace -chan with tone, not suffix.

samples.jp: ダンクーガは獣を超え、人を超えた神の戦士なんだ！ 負けるわけないね！
samples.en: Dancouga's beyond beast and beyond man - a warrior god! No way we lose!

samples.jp: 寒いし、パーッと片づけて帰ろうぜ！
samples.en: It's freezing. Let's wrap this up fast and go home!

voice_cards.personality: Commander-type ace of the Black Wing and Cyber Beast Force supervisor; serious, strategic, a little aloof.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore/watashi(rare); firm, officer-like ～だ, ～だな, ～するな; ～たまえ-free. Calls Shinobu by surname "藤原".
voice_cards.tics: "藤原! 断空剣を使え!"
voice_cards.address: Shinobu as "Fujiwara"; others formally; Connect leaders as "スオル団長" (Commander Suol).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Clipped military calm; complete sentences; few contractions in orders. Address Shinobu as "Fujiwara" to keep the distance.

samples.jp: 獣戦機隊は問題児が多いが腕は確かだ。 今後ともよろしく頼む。
samples.en: The Cyber Beast Force is full of troublemakers, but their skill is real. I'm counting on you.

samples.jp: 藤原！　断空剣を使え！
samples.en: Fujiwara! Use the Danku Sword!

voice_cards.jp: キリコ・キュービィー
voice_cards.personality: Taciturn former Red Shoulder, an "abnormal survivor" haunted by his past. Speaks little, cold and precise, yet quietly protective.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore; terse plain form, lots of trailing "…", minimal particles (～だ, ～か…). Polite 自分 + desu/masu toward military superiors.
voice_cards.tics: Ellipses and silence ("…!"); flat observations ("戦場はどこでも変わらない").
voice_cards.address: Comrades by name (Gotho, Vanilla, Shako, Zaki); superiors "隊長"; enemies "あんた/奴".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Extremely spare: short declaratives, often fragments; keep the "..." beats. No contractions-heavy chatter, no exclamations except in combat. Laconic noir feel.

samples.jp: 別の宇宙でも敵はバララントか…。 地獄の風景はどこも変わらんらしいな。
samples.en: Balarant again, even in another universe... Seems hell looks the same everywhere.

samples.jp: …あんたのような男は何度も見てきた。
samples.en: ...I've seen men like you before.

voice_cards.jp: ギャブレット・ギャブレー
voice_cards.personality: Vain, ambitious, flamboyant Posaydal knight and Daba's rival; grandiose, comically self-serious, later an ally.
voice_cards.register_jp: Watashi; archaic-pompous knightly: ～せん, ～ではないか, 貴様, ～してくれる!; "フッフッフッ".
voice_cards.tics: "セイバーの錆にしてくれる" (taste my saber), "出世" (career ambition), "戦いは優雅でなくてはな!"
voice_cards.address: Daba as "ダバ"/"貴様"; Olibee as "クワサン・オリビー"; enemies "貴様".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Grandiloquent, slightly old-fashioned: "I shall", "you dare", no contractions when posturing. Comedy comes from pomposity undercut by reality. "Heh heh heh!"

samples.jp: 戦いは優雅でなくてはな！
samples.en: A battle must be elegant!

samples.jp: なにを…！ 私を侮辱するのならば、セイバーの錆にしてくれる！
samples.en: What...?! Insult me and you shall taste my saber!

voice_cards.personality: One of the Thirteen, Giwaza's lover and loyal officer; proud, aggressive, mocking.
voice_cards.register_jp: Watashi; mixes commanding ～だ/～おらん with taunting feminine-rough ～じゃないのさ, ～だね, ～かい.
voice_cards.tics: "お嬢ちゃん" (little girl), "ボウヤ"; "覚悟するんだね!"
voice_cards.address: "ギワザ様" (Lord Giwaza); enemies "お嬢ちゃん/ボウヤ".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Haughty, sneering femme-fatale officer; switch between crisp command lines and taunts ("Not bad, little girl"). Contractions in taunts.

samples.jp: 私は１３人衆のネイ・モー・ハンだぞ！ 貴様らに屈するほど落ちぶれてはおらん！
samples.en: I am Nei Moh Han of the Thirteen! I haven't sunk so low as to kneel to the likes of you!

samples.jp: いい覚悟だ。 いくよ、お嬢ちゃん！
samples.en: I like your nerve. Here I come, little girl!

voice_cards.personality: Woodo black-marketeer and Chirico's fatherly business partner; savvy, greedy-but-loyal, folksy.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore; rough middle-aged merchant speech: ～だぜ, ～ねぇ, ～さ, ～な; 旦那 for clients.
voice_cards.tics: "旦那" ("boss/mister"); money and deals.
voice_cards.address: Chirico, Vanilla by name; clients "旦那" (e.g. Domon) -> "pal/boss".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Wheeler-dealer uncle: relaxed, contractions, colloquial ("Connect pays well"). Avoid crude swearing.

samples.jp: コネクトは払いがいいんでね。 最後まで付き合うぜ、ドモンの旦那。
samples.en: Connect pays well, so I'm in till the end, Domon my friend.

samples.jp: みんな聞いてくれ。 街から出る算段がついたぞ。
samples.en: Listen up, everyone. I've found us a way out of town.

voice_cards.personality: Japanese youth summoned to Byston Well who became the Holy Warrior piloting Dunbine/Billbine; earnest, passionate, quick-tempered at evil.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore; standard young male: ～だ, ～ない, ～かよ; some soft ～さ. Speaks of "善き/悪しきオーラ".
voice_cards.tics: "オーラ力", "悪しきオーラ"; invokes "エレ様…シーラ様…".
voice_cards.address: Cham by name; Bern/Black Knight as "バーン"; Elle and Ciela with 様 (Lady Elle, Queen Ciela).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Sincere young hero; natural contractions; moral outbursts ("Why side with an evil aura?!"). Keep aura terms consistent.

samples.jp: なぜ悪しきオーラに身を寄せる！ それでは人々を幸せにすることはできない！
samples.en: Why give yourself to an evil aura?! That'll never bring anyone happiness!

samples.jp: エレ様…シーラ様…俺に悪を倒す力を！
samples.en: Lady Elle... Queen Ciela... Give me the strength to defeat evil!

voice_cards.personality: Tiny Mi Ferario fairy who rides with Show; lively, emotional, bossy and childlike.
voice_cards.register_jp: Atashi; childlike feminine: ～よ, ～わ, ～の?, stretched vowels (ショウ～, えっらそ～).
voice_cards.tics: Constant "ショウ!" cries; "ダメェェ!"
voice_cards.address: Show by name constantly.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Short, bouncy, exclamatory; childlike word choice ("Show, that's so scary!"). Use stretched letters sparingly ("Shoooow!").

samples.jp: 何あれ、えっらそ～に！
samples.en: Who does he think he is, all high and mighty?!

samples.jp: 帰ろう、ショウ。 バイストン・ウェルに！
samples.en: Let's go home, Show. Back to Byston Well!

voice_cards.personality: Masked Bern Bunnings, disgraced knight consumed by hatred of Show; theatrical, bitter, obsessed with honor and revenge.
voice_cards.register_jp: Watashi; stiff archaic-knightly: 貴様, ～のだ, ～せぬ, 不覚を取った, 怨讐の剣.
voice_cards.tics: "フフフ…", calls Show by full name "ショウ・ザマ"; "勝利をこの剣に誓う!"
voice_cards.address: Show as "Show Zama"/"貴様"; superiors with 様.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Formal, dramatic, no contractions; archaic touches ("I swear victory upon this sword!"). Seething menace.

samples.jp: 名と素顔を捨てた時、騎士としての矜持も捨てたのだ！ 今の私には怨讐の剣あるのみ！
samples.en: When I cast off my name and face, I cast off a knight's pride as well! All I have now is the sword of vengeance!

samples.jp: 待たせたな、ショウ・ザマ。
samples.en: I have kept you waiting, Show Zama.

voice_cards.personality: Gradosian commander-prince, arrogant elitist who believes in rule by the superior few; cultured, cold, contemptuous of Earthlings.
voice_cards.register_jp: Watashi; lofty formal: ～のだ, ～のだよ, ～せぬ, 貴様; aristocratic "フッ".
voice_cards.tics: Contempt words "猿", "野蛮", "愚か者め!"; laughs "ハッハッハ!"
voice_cards.address: Roan by full name "ロアン・デミトリッヒ"; Eiji as "エイジ・アスカ"; enemies 貴様.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Polished, imperious; no contractions; elevated vocabulary ("insolent", "fools"). Long rhetorical sentences about order and rule.

samples.jp: 支配とは高みより下界を掌握すること。 ひと握りの優秀なる者によってこそ この宇宙の平和と安定は維持されるのだ！
samples.en: To rule is to command the world below from on high. Only a superior few can preserve the peace and stability of this universe!

samples.jp: 愚か者めっ！！
samples.en: Fools!!

voice_cards.jp: ジャン・ポール・ロッチナ
voice_cards.personality: Melkian intelligence officer obsessed with studying Chirico; cool, clinical, scheming.
voice_cards.register_jp: Watashi; formal, keigo to Pailsen (～です, ～ますかな?), plain ～だ to subordinates.
voice_cards.tics: Probability/data talk ("98%以上の確度"), "閣下" for Pailsen.
voice_cards.address: Pailsen as "閣下" (Your Excellency/General); Chirico by name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Clinical, bureaucratic; precise numbers; formal "sir" register with Pailsen. Minimal emotion.

samples.jp: 我々の勝利はほぼ確定しました。 作戦は９８％以上の確度で計画通り進行中です。
samples.en: Our victory is all but certain. The operation is proceeding as planned, with over 98% confidence.

samples.jp: ペールゼン閣下、ご報告があります。
samples.en: General Pailsen, I have a report.

voice_cards.personality: Veteran leader of the Barcoff Squad; gruff, pragmatic, warm underneath, protective of his misfits.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore; rough NCO speech: ～ぜ, ～だな, ～しろ; "坊や" for Zaki.
voice_cards.tics: "坊や" (kid); "ヒュウ!"
voice_cards.address: Squad by name (Kochak, Godan, Chirico); Zaki "坊や".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Gruff sergeant: contractions, practical orders, dry encouragement ("Hold on, every second counts!").

samples.jp: ヒュウ！　やるじゃないか、坊や！
samples.en: Whew! Not bad, kid!

samples.jp: 本隊に見捨てられた俺達をわざわざ助けるとは コネクト・フォースってのは酔狂の集まりらしいな。
samples.en: Rescuing guys the main army left for dead? Connect Force must be a bunch of oddballs.

voice_cards.personality: Hulking, short-tempered Barcoff Squad member with a mercenary streak; cynical, bullying.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore; coarse: てめぇ, ～やがる, ～だぜ, ～な!
voice_cards.tics: "死になっ!", "いただきだ!"
voice_cards.address: Barcoff as "分隊長" (Squad Leader); Kochak with contempt.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Coarse, aggressive, cynical; contractions and mild profanity; short barks.

samples.jp: …ったく、図太い神経してやがるぜ。
samples.en: ...Damn, you've got some nerve.

samples.jp: そうすりゃ俺達も 晴れて不死身の兵隊さんの仲間入りだ！
samples.en: Then we'd all be official members of the immortal soldiers club!

voice_cards.jp: ゲレンボラッシュ・ドロカ・ザキ
voice_cards.personality: 16-year-old Barcoff Squad member, secretly conditioned to kill Chirico; defensive, insecure, tough-talking.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore; youthful rough: ～だろ, ～ねぇ, ～かよ.
voice_cards.tics: Jumpy "なんだ!?"; quiet "いや、いいんだ".
voice_cards.address: Barcoff "分隊長"; Chirico by name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Young tough with cracks showing; short, blunt lines; contractions; let vulnerability peek through brief lines.

samples.jp: 助けてもらっておいて 無賃乗車ってわけにはいかねぇよ。
samples.en: You saved us. Can't just ride along for free.

samples.jp: あ、ありがとよ、キリコ…。
samples.en: Th-thanks, Chirico...

voice_cards.personality: Cowardly, paranoid mechanic of the Barcoff Squad; panics easily, grasps at the idea of being an abnormal survivor.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore; whiny rough: ～じゃねぇか, ～かよ, "ひいっ!", nervous laughter "へへへ".
voice_cards.tics: Shrieks "ひいいっ!"; hysterical laughs.
voice_cards.address: Barcoff "分隊長" (sarcastically at times).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Panicky, whiny; stammers ("Wh-what?!"), self-serving gripes. Contractions; stutters sparingly.

samples.jp: 異能生存体でも、なんでもいい！ 生き残る可能性があるなら、俺もそいつに賭ける！
samples.en: Abnormal survivor, whatever! If it means I live, I'm betting on it too!

samples.jp: ひいいっ！　俺のせいか！？
samples.en: Eeek! Is it my fault?!

voice_cards.jp: ロアン・デミトリッヒ
voice_cards.personality: Earth-born youth who embraces Gradosian culture, rising to command the Grados fleet; earnest, polite, a collaborator who comes to believe in coexistence.
voice_cards.register_jp: Boku (to Eiji/peers), watashi (official); polite desu/masu throughout; formal reports to "閣下".
voice_cards.tics: Formal military reporting; "ル・カイン閣下".
voice_cards.address: Le Cain as "閣下/ル・カイン様"; Eiji by name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Polite, earnest, slightly stiff; full sentences, few contractions in reports, softer with Eiji.

samples.jp: 閣下、グラドス軍の兵を退かせます！
samples.en: Your Excellency, I'll pull back the Grados forces!

samples.jp: 僕にできることをしただけです。
samples.en: I only did what I could.

voice_cards.personality: Kuent warrior and ex-battling pilot; laconic, steady, honorable.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore; terse masculine, ～だ, ～か, ～ろ.
voice_cards.tics: References Kuent pride ("クエント人として").
voice_cards.address: Chirico, Gotho by name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Calm and economical like Chirico but warmer; short declaratives.

samples.jp: いつものバトリング相手の動きじゃない。 連中…殺し屋かもしれんな。
samples.en: That's not how battling opponents move. These guys... might be killers.

samples.jp: いいから行け！ 俺達のことは心配するな！
samples.en: Just go! Don't worry about us!

voice_cards.personality: Motor-mouthed Woodo mechanic and pilot, Coconna's boyfriend; loud, excitable, comic but loyal.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore; fast slangy Tokyo: ～ぜ, ～じゃないの, ～かよ!, "うっひょ～"; "キリコちゃん".
voice_cards.tics: "キリコちゃん", "うっひょ～!", "甘い、甘い!"
voice_cards.address: Chirico as "キリコちゃん" (drop suffix; use "buddy"/playful tone).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Fast, jokey, colloquial; exclamations, slang; comic exaggeration.

samples.jp: うっひょ～！ これが、コネクト・フォースの戦艦かよ。
samples.en: Whoa-ho! So this is a Connect Force battleship!

samples.jp: いい仲間がいるじゃないのよ、キリコちゃん！
samples.en: You've got some good friends there, Chirico buddy!

voice_cards.personality: Scheming Posaydal commander (No. 3 of the Thirteen) who rebels to seize power; proud, calculating, pompous.
voice_cards.register_jp: Watashi; formal commanding: ～だ, ～か!, 王たる私.
voice_cards.tics: Calls himself king-like ("王たる私"); "ヘビーメタル隊発進!"
voice_cards.address: Nei by name; Daba full name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Grand, commanding, no contractions in orders; speeches about justice and order.

samples.jp: ヘビーメタル隊発進！
samples.en: Heavy Metal squad, launch!

samples.jp: 王たる私に攻撃を当てる者などいるはずがあるまい！
samples.en: None may lay a hand on one who is to be king!

voice_cards.personality: The real dictator, long disguised as Amandra Kamandra; manipulative puppet-master, smugly amused.
voice_cards.register_jp: Watashi; urbane, ironic: ～のだよ, ～かね?, ～ではないか; addresses Daba as "ダバ・マイロード君".
voice_cards.tics: Theatre metaphors ("舞台", "観客"); "フフフ…".
voice_cards.address: Daba "Daba Myroad" (mock-courteous).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Silky, condescending, witty; complete sentences, rhetorical questions.

samples.jp: フフフ…。 民衆は何も知らず、ただ私が演出する舞台の 観客でありさえすればいいのだよ。
samples.en: Heh heh... The people need know nothing. They need only be the audience for the play I direct.

samples.jp: ダバ・マイロード君。
samples.en: My dear Daba Myroad.

voice_cards.personality: Hidden heir of Koam leading the rebellion against Posaydal; kind, earnest, responsible, gentle unless angered.
voice_cards.register_jp: Ore; gentle masculine standard: ～だ, ～よ, ～な; polite with elders.
voice_cards.tics: Rallying "打倒ポセイダル".
voice_cards.address: Amm, Leccee, Kyao by name; Olibee as "オリビー".
voice_cards.english_guidance: Warm, steady hero; natural contractions; sincere encouragement. Avoid slang.

samples.jp: 打倒ポセイダルに燃える人々の火を 消させはしない！
samples.en: I won't let the fire of those fighting Posaydal be put out!

samples.jp: キャオ、全速力で離脱だ！
samples.en: Kyao, full speed, get us out of here!

voice_cards.personality: Former head of the Thirteen turned rebel; mature, sharp, tactically minded, rival to Amm for Daba.

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (5th grade, about 10-11). Hot-headed, lazy-about-school leader and main pilot of Raijin-Oh. Brash, impulsive, loves fighting and hates homework, but brave and loyal; constantly bickers with class president Maria.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺 (35x); rough boyish casual: ～ぜ, ～ぞ, ～じゃんか, ～かよ, ～ねぇ (contracted negatives), drawn-out complaints (不公平だぁぁぁ！). No keigo.
voice_cards.tics: けっ…!, へへ, おう！/おうよ！, 了解、りょ～かい！ (sing-song 'roger'), いくぜ、みんな！
voice_cards.address: Plain given names: Maria, Asuka, Koji (no suffix). Teachers as 先生. Older heroes as アニキ (e.g. カミナのアニキ -> 'Bro Kamina' or just 'Kamina').
voice_cards.english_guidance: Write a cocky 10-year-old: short punchy sentences, heavy contractions ('gonna', 'ain't' sparingly, 'c'mon'), exclamations. Kid vocabulary - no swearing beyond 'jerk', 'darn', 'geez'. Avoid adult slang or teen edginess. Whines are drawn out ('No faaair!').

samples.jp: 俺達が来たからには、もう安心だぜ！
samples.en: We're here now, so you can relax!

samples.jp: 先手必勝だ！　いくぜ！
samples.en: First strike wins! Let's go!

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (5th grade, about 10-11). Cool, composed second pilot (Ken-Oh side) and Jin's rival/friend. Calm, smart and a bit aloof, the voice of reason who still has a quiet competitive streak.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕; calm casual, ～だ, ～な, ～だろう; occasional polite ありがとうございます to adults; ironic フッ.
voice_cards.tics: フッ… (cool scoff), 一人で突っ走るなよ (to Jin).
voice_cards.address: Jin, Koji, Maria by given name; adults with polite forms (団長 -> 'Captain').
voice_cards.english_guidance: Clean, measured sentences; fewer exclamation marks than Jin; light dry humor. Still a kid: avoid sophisticated adult diction. Contractions fine.

samples.jp: 一人で突っ走るなよ。
samples.en: Don't go charging off on your own.

samples.jp: 子供だから、見えることもある！
samples.en: Some things you can only see because you're a kid!

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (5th grade, about 10-11). Gentle, timid but kind boy who pilots alongside Jin; believes in UFOs/aliens, a bit of a crybaby who finds courage for his friends.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕; soft polite-casual: ～だよ, ～だね, ～よね, ～かな; questions ending ～なの？/～んだよ？
voice_cards.tics: あはは…, もしかして…宇宙人とか！？, 仁くん, やるぅ！
voice_cards.address: 仁くん (Jin) - drop -kun; softness carried by tone. Maria, Asuka plain.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Soft, earnest, slightly hesitant ('Um...', 'you know?'). Gentle encouragement. Avoid aggressive phrasing; when brave, keep it simple ('I'll do it!').

samples.jp: でも、僕達はまだ小学生なんだよ？
samples.en: But we're still just in elementary school, you know?
