voice_cards.register_jp: 私; feminine casual: ～わ, ～よ, ～のよ, ～でしょ！, ～なさい; formal when chairing (～します/終わります).
voice_cards.tics: 地球防衛組、出動よ！ ('Earth Defense Class, move out!'), 笑ってる場合じゃないでしょ！, あんた達 (scolding).
voice_cards.address: Jin, Asuka plain; 勉くん etc. (drop -kun); あんた達 when scolding the boys.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Brisk, bossy schoolgirl: imperatives, 'Come on!', 'Seriously!'. Use a more formal register in meeting lines ('That concludes the meeting.'). No adult sarcasm; keep it kid-appropriate.

samples.jp: よぉぉし！　地球防衛組、出動よ！
samples.en: All right! Earth Defense Class, move out!

samples.jp: 笑ってる場合じゃないでしょ！
samples.en: This is no time to be laughing!

voice_cards.personality: Adult homeroom teacher of Class 5-3; warm, idealistic and a little goofy, deeply proud of his students.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕 / 先生 as self-reference to kids; plain teacher speech ～だ, ～ぞ; polite ～ですか to adults; clears throat (おっほん).
voice_cards.tics: え～…おっほん！, よし、授業はこれで終わりだ。
voice_cards.address: Students by given or family name without suffix (池田, ときえ).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Friendly teacher voice: complete sentences, gentle authority, mild humor. 'All right, class...' framing. Avoid stiffness.

samples.jp: 教師に一番必要なのは知識じゃない。
samples.en: Knowledge isn't the most important thing a teacher needs.

samples.jp: よし、授業はこれで終わりだ。
samples.en: All right, that's it for today's lesson.

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (6th grade, about 11-12). Hot-blooded main pilot of Go-Saurer. Mischievous, sporty troublemaker who gets fired up easily and resents being bossed around, but has a huge heart.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺 (50x); rough boyish ～ぜ, ～ぞ, ～だろ, ～やがって; elongated battle shouts.
voice_cards.tics: 燃えてきたぜ！ ('I'm getting fired up!'), 腕が鳴るぜ！, いくぞ、みんな！, attack names shouted.
voice_cards.address: Classmates by given name (Kinta, Shinobu, Elly); 教授 -> 'Professor'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Energetic, sporty kid; short exclamations, 'Alright!', 'Bring it on!'. Mild kid insults ('show-off'). Differentiate from Jin by more 'fired up' passion vocabulary.

samples.jp: うおぉぉぉ、燃えてきたぜ！
samples.en: Whoaaa, now I'm all fired up!

samples.jp: なんだよ、お姉さんぶりやがって…。
samples.en: Geez, quit acting like you're my big sister...

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (6th grade, about 11-12). Gentle, timid BOY co-pilot (Land Stego); manga lover, kind and supportive of Kenichi; grows braver. Note: male despite the name.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕; soft ～だね, ～よね, ～じゃない？; no rough endings.
voice_cards.tics: こういう時、マンガだと確か… ('In manga, at times like this...'), やろう、拳一君！
voice_cards.address: 拳一君 -> 'Kenichi' (drop -kun).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Soft-spoken boy: mild words, a little hesitant; supportive cheering. Use he/him for him in others' lines.

samples.jp: やろう、拳一君！僕達はザウラーズなんだ！
samples.en: Let's do it, Kenichi! We're the Saurers!

samples.jp: ちょっと怖くなってきた…。
samples.en: I'm starting to get kind of scared...

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (6th grade, about 11-12). Tomboyish, confident girl pilot (Thunder Brachio); level-headed and teasing, keeps Kenichi in check.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; feminine casual ～よ, ～わね, ～なさいよ, ～でしょう; teasing 何ビビってんの.
voice_cards.tics: 拳一、落ち着きなさいよ！, ～君 for Hiromi.
voice_cards.address: Kenichi plain; ひろみ君 -> 'Hiromi'; 教授 -> 'Professor'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Confident, a bit sassy, sensible. Short scolding imperatives ('Calm down!'). Kid-level vocabulary.

samples.jp: 拳一、落ち着きなさいよ！
samples.en: Kenichi, calm down!

samples.jp: 何ビビってんの、ひろみ君、クーコ。
samples.en: What are you two so scared of, Hiromi, Kuko?

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (6th grade, about 11-12). Big, burly classmate 'Kinta', pilot of Magnasaurer; ex-rival turned dependable muscle of the team; blunt and proud.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; rough ～ぜ, ～ぞ, ～だ; tough-guy encouragements (しっかりしろ、お前ら！).
voice_cards.tics: しっかりしろ、お前ら！, 情けないぞ！
voice_cards.address: Kenichi, Yoji by given name; お前ら to the group.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Gruff big-kid voice: blunt, 'Get it together!', simple strong words. Not adult; avoid swearing.

samples.jp: しっかりしろ、お前ら！
samples.en: Pull yourselves together, guys!

samples.jp: オリジナルの俺達がコピーに負けてたまるかよ！
samples.en: No way the real us are losing to a bunch of copies!

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (6th grade, about 11-12). Studious cram-school kid, pilot of Gransaurer; analytical, a bit nerdy, compares everything to entrance exams; earnest.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕 (22x); polite-casual ～だよ, ～じゃないか, ～かもしれない; analytical vocabulary.
voice_cards.tics: 熱血最強！グランザウラァァーッ！！ (his summoning cry), exam/private-school metaphors.
voice_cards.address: Plain given names; 君 to rivals.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Bookish kid: slightly more complex vocabulary than Kenichi ('analysis', 'probability'), but still a kid. Keep exam jokes ('harder than a prep-school entrance exam').

samples.jp: この状況を覆すのは、有名私立の問題を解くより難しいぞ…！
samples.en: Turning this around is harder than a prep-school entrance exam...!

samples.jp: ビビッちゃダメだ！
samples.en: Don't chicken out now!

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (6th grade, about 11-12). 'Elly', the Saurers' bossy leader/class rep; organized, commanding, explosive when angry (うがあああ!).
voice_cards.register_jp: Avoids pronouns; feminine commanding ～わよ, ～よ, ～しょう, ～なさいよ.
voice_cards.tics: ザウラーズ、出動よ！ ('Saurers, move out!'), うがあああっ！まったく、冗談じゃないわっ！
voice_cards.address: 拳一 plain (often scolding), ユカ, 教授 -> 'Professor'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Team-leader voice: crisp orders, exclamation-heavy, occasional comic outburst. Parallel Maria but slightly more fiery.

samples.jp: 了解！　ザウラーズ、出動よ！
samples.en: Roger! Saurers, move out!

samples.jp: 何やってんのよ、拳一！ちゃんと避けなさいよ！
samples.en: What are you doing, Kenichi?! Dodge properly!

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (6th grade, about 11-12). 'Professor' - the class genius and Go-Saurer's analyst/programmer; speaks politely to everyone, loves calculations and perpetual-motion research.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; consistently polite ～です/～ます even to classmates; 皆さん, ～君.
voice_cards.tics: 再計算の結果が出ました！, 計算外です！, 永久機関 (perpetual-motion machine).
voice_cards.address: 皆さん -> 'everyone'; 拳一君 -> 'Kenichi'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Polite, precise little scientist: full sentences, no contractions or few ('It is...'), technical terms, 'Everyone, please...'. Comic contrast with her age; keep sentences short.

samples.jp: 再計算の結果が出ました！
samples.en: The recalculation results are in!

samples.jp: こ、これは計算外のダメージです！
samples.en: Th-this damage wasn't in my calculations!

voice_cards.personality: Supreme ruler of the Mechanization Empire; cold machine-god who wants to impose an 'Order of Steel' on the universe; arrogant, contemptuous of emotion.
voice_cards.register_jp: 我/余/私; archaic villain ～のだ, ～ぬ, ～しおって, 貴様; imperial self-reference 余.
voice_cards.tics: 全宇宙に鋼鉄の秩序を！ ('Order of Steel to the whole universe!'), フフフ…, 小賢しい.
voice_cards.address: 貴様/貴様ら -> 'you'/'you fools'; コネクト・フォース by name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Grandiose villain: formal, no contractions, archaic touches ('Thou' NOT needed; use 'I shall', 'insolent'). Keep 'Order of Steel' consistent.

samples.jp: 全宇宙に鋼鉄の秩序を！
samples.en: Bring the Order of Steel to the entire universe!

samples.jp: 勇者の妄想に酔いしれる時代は終わった。
samples.en: The age of drunken fantasies about heroes is over.

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (4th grade, about 9-10). Ninja-descended prankster and main pilot of Ganbaruger; cocky, impulsive, girl-crazy, hates lectures, but has a strong sense of justice.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; very rough slangy ～ぜ, ～ねぇ, ～かよ, あったぼうよ, にゃにぃぃ！？ (comic 'whaaat?!').
voice_cards.tics: 元気爆発！ガンバルガァァ！！, へへっ、どんなもんだい！, あったぼうよ！ ('You bet!').
voice_cards.address: Plain given names (鷹介, 力哉, 千夏); 千夏の奴.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Brattier and goofier than Jin/Kenichi: slangy ('y'know', 'whaddaya'), comic outbursts ('Whaaat?!'). Youngest-sounding hero; very short sentences.

samples.jp: 遊びでヒーローやってるわけじゃないんだぜ！
samples.en: We're not playing hero for fun, y'know!

samples.jp: へへっ、どんなもんだい！
samples.en: Heh heh, how d'ya like that!

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (4th grade, about 9-10). Gentle, artistic boy (pilot of Gekiryuger); kind and earnest, mediates between Kotaro and Rikiya, determined to protect others.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕; soft ～だよ, ～だね, ～よね; uses ～君 for friends.
voice_cards.tics: 虎太郎君、力哉君, 僕の目の前で誰も傷つけさせるもんか！
voice_cards.address: 虎太郎君/力哉君 -> 'Kotaro'/'Rikiya'; 百合香さん -> 'Yurika'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Polite, sincere, gentle; complete simple sentences; brave lines stay earnest, not cocky.

samples.jp: 僕の目の前で誰も傷つけさせるもんか！
samples.en: I won't let anyone get hurt right in front of me!

samples.jp: なに言ってんだよ、虎太郎くん！
samples.en: What are you talking about, Kotaro?!

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (4th grade, about 9-10). Cool, athletic rival of Kotaro and the level-headed one of the Ganba Team; tough, serious and quick to scold Kotaro's slacking.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; firm boyish ～だ, ～ぞ, ～ろよ, まったくだ.
voice_cards.tics: 調子に乗るなよ、虎太郎！, まったくだ ('Tell me about it').
voice_cards.address: Kotaro, Yosuke plain.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Cool, clipped sentences; mature-for-his-age but still a kid. Fewer slang words than Kotaro.

samples.jp: 調子に乗るなよ、虎太郎！
samples.en: Don't get cocky, Kotaro!

samples.jp: どうした、虎太郎！今のは避けられたぞ！
samples.en: What's wrong, Kotaro? You could've dodged that!

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (5th grade, about 10-11). 'Momotaro', hot-blooded leader and Daiteioh pilot of the Dankets; eager to measure up to the senior Eldran teams; competitive, a bit thin-skinned.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺 (49x); rough ～ぜ, ～だよ, ～な, ～ろぉぜ!
voice_cards.tics: 完全勝利 ('total victory'), ダンケッツ魂、見せてやろぉぉぜ！, 燃えるぜ！
voice_cards.address: Mai, Kakeru, Hiryu plain; senior teams as 先輩達 -> 'our seniors'/'the veterans'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Gung-ho kid: short sentences, 'Let's show 'em!'. Use 'total victory' as his motif. Slightly more modern-sounding than the 1990s kids.

samples.jp: 敵が強ければ強いほど燃えるぜ！
samples.en: The tougher the enemy, the more fired up I get!

samples.jp: それは、俺達が完全勝利することだ！
samples.en: It's us winning a total victory, that's what!

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (5th grade, about 10-11). Bright, sharp-tongued girl on the Dankets; teases and nags Momotaro but supports the team.
voice_cards.register_jp: 私; feminine casual ～よ, ～わ, ～でしょう, ～てよね, もう！
voice_cards.tics: もう！しょうがないなぁ！, 人のせいにしないでよね！
voice_cards.address: Momotaro plain (モモタロウってば...).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Lively, tart schoolgirl; quick retorts, 'Geez!', 'Honestly!'.

samples.jp: モモタロウ、早く攻撃して！
samples.en: Momotaro, attack already!

samples.jp: 今のはモモタロウが悪いんでしょう！人のせいにしないでよね！
samples.en: That one was your fault, Momotaro! Don't go blaming other people!

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (5th grade, about 10-11). Easygoing, steady Dankets member and big fan of the Saurers; calms Momotaro down.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺 (casual) but soft; ～ぜ, ～だよ, ～さ; repeats advice (平常心).
voice_cards.tics: 平常心だよ ('stay calm'), ザウラーズ fan remarks.
voice_cards.address: Momotaro plain.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Relaxed, friendly, supportive; light humor; fanboy enthusiasm for the Saurers.

samples.jp: ビビってんなよ、モモタロウ！
samples.en: Don't chicken out, Momotaro!

samples.jp: こういう時こそ平常心だよ、モモタロウ。平常心
samples.en: Times like this call for a cool head, Momotaro. A cool head.

voice_cards.personality: Elementary-school kid (5th grade, about 10-11). Elite, aloof rival-ally (Dairyuoh pilot), Asuka's cousin; arrogant, condescending, coolly competent; secretly proud of the Eldran legacy.
voice_cards.register_jp: 僕 (35x); haughty ～たまえ, ～だな, ～だ, 君 for others; proverbs.
voice_cards.tics: 後ろで見ていたまえ ('watch from the back'), フッ, ふう…話にならない.
voice_cards.address: 君 -> 'you'; モモタロウ plain.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Smug little prodigy: precise, slightly old-fashioned diction ('Pathetic.', 'I suggest you...'), no slang. Keep sentences short and cutting.

samples.jp: あとは僕にまかせて、後ろで見ていたまえ
samples.en: Leave the rest to me and watch from the back.

samples.jp: ふう…話にならない…。
samples.en: Hmph... pathetic...

voice_cards.personality: Adult leader of the Good Thunder Team and GoShogun's pilot; laid-back, witty ex-special-forces man with an easygoing, joking style who gets serious when needed.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; relaxed adult male ～だぜ, ～な, ～さ, おいおい; English OK, OK!
voice_cards.tics: ゴーショーグンＧＯ！ ('GoShogun, GO!'), ＯＫ、ＯＫ！, ビムラーのお導き ('the Beamler's guidance').
voice_cards.address: Remy, Killy plain; kids by given name.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Wry adult banter, light sarcasm, 80s cool-guy vibe; contractions; understatement ('This is a bit rough.'). Contrasts with kid casts.

samples.jp: いくぞ！　ゴーショーグンＧＯ！
samples.en: Here we go! GoShogun, GO!

samples.jp: おいおい、決め台詞が台無しだぜ…。
samples.en: Come on, you totally ruined my big line...

voice_cards.personality: Adult wisecracking ex-gang leader and GoShogun co-pilot; streetwise, sarcastic, loves a carefree drifter life.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺; slangy ～ねぇ, ～だぜ, ～ときたもんだ; ironic politeness (ご精が出ますな).
voice_cards.tics: やれやれ, おいおい, ヨロシクな!
voice_cards.address: Shingo, Remy plain; mock-polite to enemies.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Sardonic quips, mock-formal jabs ('My, my, how diligent.'), relaxed slang. Adult; mild profanity avoided (game rating).

samples.jp: やれやれ、こんなに寒いのに精が出るねぇ。
samples.en: My, my, working that hard in this cold? Admirable.

samples.jp: 真吾、客が多いからってあがんなよ
samples.en: Shingo, don't get stage fright just 'cause we've got a big crowd.

voice_cards.personality: Adult glamorous, flirtatious former agent and GoShogun co-pilot; teasing, cheerful, tough under the charm.
voice_cards.register_jp: あたし/私; feminine adult ～わよ, ～わね, ～かしら, ～ちゃう, うふっ, ♪
voice_cards.tics: ちょっとぉ！, うふっ, お嫁に行かなきゃ (running joke about marrying), 男の子！
voice_cards.address: Shingo, Killy plain; 二人とも ('you two'); ボーイさん ('boys').
voice_cards.english_guidance: Playful, flirty adult woman; teasing big-sister tone; light innuendo only. Use 'honey/boys' sparingly. Drop the ♪ in English or render the lilt with wording.

samples.jp: うふっ、あたしも早く片づけてお嫁に行かなきゃ
samples.en: Ooh, I'd better wrap this up fast so I can go get married.

samples.jp: 弱音を吐かない。男の子！
samples.en: No whining. You're a boy, aren't you?

voice_cards.personality: About 11-year-old hero who merges with Jushin Liger; cocky, hot-headed gaki-daisho type with a mischievous (slightly lecherous) streak, hates bullies.
voice_cards.register_jp: 俺 (46x); rough ～ぜ, ～かよ, ～やがれ, ～ってんだ; 姉ちゃん/さん to older people.
voice_cards.tics: 来い！ライガー！！ (summon cry), サンダー電撃スラッシュ！, やい、～野郎！
voice_cards.address: Yui, Mai plain; older girls ～姉ちゃん ('Ranka, Sheryl' - drop or 'sis'); older men ～さん (drop).
voice_cards.english_guidance: Rough-and-tumble kid: brash, punchy, 'Bring it!', 'You creep!'. Like Jin but scrappier. Keep kid-appropriate.

samples.jp: 来い！　返り討ちにしてやるぜ！
samples.en: Bring it! I'll send you packing!

samples.jp: ありがとよ、ランカ姉ちゃん、シェリル姉ちゃん。
samples.en: Thanks a bunch, Ranka, Sheryl!

voice_cards.personality: Ancient evil god of the Drago Empire who feeds on the dark desires of humans; mocking, sadistic, immortal while evil exists.
voice_cards.register_jp: 我 (40x); archaic ～ぞ, ～よ, ～おる, ～のだ, 貴様, 虫ケラ; booming laughs.
voice_cards.tics: フハハハ！, フフフ…, 絶望せよ ('Despair!'), 恐怖せよ.
voice_cards.address: 貴様/人間 -> 'you'/'mortal(s)', 虫ケラ -> 'insects'.
voice_cards.english_guidance: Archaic, grandiose demon god: 'mortals', 'insects', imperatives ('Despair!'), no contractions. Slow menacing rhythm.

samples.jp: その暗き心こそ、我が力の源よ！！
samples.en: That darkness in your heart is the very source of my power!!

samples.jp: 地上に邪念が溢れている限り我は不死身なのだ
samples.en: So long as evil fills the world above, I am immortal.
